FILE: face-trajectory/cpp/include/face_trajectory/shared_json.hpp
SHA256: 33a934dd98cf97e6567785b839f9a2f35b33510e5dbb1455f654d84a445f14aa
================================================================================
L000001: #pragma once
L000002: #include "face_trajectory/state.hpp"
L000003: #include <nlohmann/json.hpp>
L000004: #include <algorithm>
L000005: #include <map>
L000006: #include <set>
L000007: #include <stdexcept>
L000008: #include <string>
L000009: #include <vector>
L000010: 
L000011: namespace face_trajectory {
L000012: // Immutable AVL sequences. Versions share unchanged subtrees, including nested
L000013: // arrays. Evidence uses observation IDs as keys, so arbitrary IDs insert locally
L000014: // rather than shifting every subsequent leaf. All other arrays use ordinal keys.
L000015: // The cache lives for one operation; no reference can survive a transaction rollback.
L000016: class SharedJson {
L000017:     using J = nlohmann::json;
L000018:     State& state_;
L000019:     std::map<std::string,J> cache_;
L000020:     std::map<std::string,J> values_;
L000021:     // ---- 跨操作备忘（同一 State 连接内共享，随 State::ObjectEpoch() 失效）----
L000022:     // 只备忘元素数 >= kMemoMinItems 的序列，主要是相机图的约 1000 条边；
L000023:     // 小序列重新读取本来就便宜，不值得占内存。每类最多 kMemoCapacity 条，先进先出淘汰。
L000024:     // 正确性只依赖"对象只增不改"：Intern 只插入不存在的键，删除/回滚都会使代号变化。
L000025:     static constexpr std::size_t kMemoMinItems = 32;
L000026:     static constexpr std::size_t kMemoCapacity = 8;
L000027:     struct Memo {
L000028:         std::uint64_t epoch = 0;
L000029:         // 作用域 + AVL 根引用 → 该序列真实 Decode 的结果（只由 Decode 写入，类型与读库一致）
L000030:         std::map<std::string,J> decoded; std::vector<std::string> decoded_order;
L000031:         // 作用域 + 是否按观测键 + 原值 dump → 从零 Build 得到的根引用（dump 相同才命中）
L000032:         std::map<std::string,std::string> built; std::vector<std::string> built_order;
L000033:     };
L000034:     Memo& M() {
L000035:         auto& slot=state_.SharedJsonMemo();
L000036:         if(!slot) slot=std::make_shared<Memo>();
L000037:         auto& memo=*static_cast<Memo*>(slot.get());
L000038:         if(memo.epoch!=state_.ObjectEpoch()) { memo=Memo{}; memo.epoch=state_.ObjectEpoch(); }
L000039:         return memo;
L000040:     }
L000041:     std::string MemoKey(const std::string& text) const { return state_.PhysicalNamespace("object")+'\x1f'+text; }
L000042:     template<class V> static void Remember(std::map<std::string,V>& map,std::vector<std::string>& order,const std::string& key,const V& value) {
L000043:         if(!map.emplace(key,value).second) return;
L000044:         order.push_back(key);
L000045:         if(order.size()>kMemoCapacity) { map.erase(order.front()); order.erase(order.begin()); }
L000046:     }
L000047:     J Node(const std::string& ref) {
L000048:         if(ref.empty()) return {{"h",0}};
L000049:         auto found=cache_.find(ref);
L000050:         if(found!=cache_.end()) return found->second;
L000051:         auto text=state_.Get("object",ref);
L000052:         if(!text) throw std::runtime_error("missing shared trajectory node");
L000053:         auto node=J::parse(*text);
L000054:         if(node.contains("value_ref")) {
L000055:             const auto value_ref=node.at("value_ref").get<std::string>();
L000056:             const auto found=values_.find(value_ref);
L000057:             if(found!=values_.end()) node["v"]=found->second;
L000058:             else {
L000059:                 const auto value=state_.Get("object",value_ref);
L000060:                 if(!value) throw std::runtime_error("missing shared trajectory value");
L000061:                 node["v"]=J::parse(*value); values_.emplace(value_ref,node.at("v"));
L000062:             }
L000063:             node.erase("value_ref");
L000064:         }
L000065:         cache_.emplace(ref,node); return node;
L000066:     }
L000067:     int Height(const std::string& ref) { return Node(ref).at("h"); }
L000068:     std::string Make(const std::string& key,const J& value,const std::string& left,const std::string& right) {
L000069:         J node={{"k",key},{"v",value},{"l",left},{"r",right},{"h",1+std::max(Height(left),Height(right))}};
L000070:         auto stored=node;
L000071:         // A path copy references an evidence body once, instead of copying that
L000072:         // body's fields at every ancestor/version. Small scalar values stay inline.
L000073:         if(value.is_object() || value.is_array()) {
L000074:             const auto ref=state_.Intern(value.dump()); values_.emplace(ref,value);
L000075:             stored.erase("v"); stored["value_ref"]=ref;
L000076:         }
L000077:         const auto ref=state_.Intern(stored.dump()); cache_.emplace(ref,std::move(node)); return ref;
L000078:     }
L000079:     std::string Balance(const std::string& key,const J& value,std::string left,std::string right) {
L000080:         if(Height(left)>Height(right)+1) {
L000081:             auto a=Node(left);
L000082:             if(Height(a.at("r"))>Height(a.at("l"))) {
L000083:                 const auto b=Node(a.at("r"));
L000084:                 left=Make(b.at("k"),b.at("v"),Make(a.at("k"),a.at("v"),a.at("l"),b.at("l")),b.at("r"));
L000085:                 a=Node(left);
L000086:             }
L000087:             return Make(a.at("k"),a.at("v"),a.at("l"),Make(key,value,a.at("r"),right));
L000088:         }
L000089:         if(Height(right)>Height(left)+1) {
L000090:             auto a=Node(right);
L000091:             if(Height(a.at("l"))>Height(a.at("r"))) {
L000092:                 const auto b=Node(a.at("l"));
L000093:                 right=Make(b.at("k"),b.at("v"),b.at("l"),Make(a.at("k"),a.at("v"),b.at("r"),a.at("r")));
L000094:                 a=Node(right);
L000095:             }
L000096:             return Make(a.at("k"),a.at("v"),Make(key,value,left,a.at("l")),a.at("r"));
L000097:         }
L000098:         return Make(key,value,left,right);
L000099:     }
L000100:     std::string Put(const std::string& ref,const std::string& key,const J& value) {
L000101:         if(ref.empty()) return Make(key,value,"","");
L000102:         const auto node=Node(ref); const auto oldkey=node.at("k").get<std::string>();
L000103:         if(key==oldkey) return Make(key,value,node.at("l"),node.at("r"));
L000104:         if(key<oldkey) return Balance(oldkey,node.at("v"),Put(node.at("l"),key,value),node.at("r"));
L000105:         return Balance(oldkey,node.at("v"),node.at("l"),Put(node.at("r"),key,value));
L000106:     }
L000107:     std::optional<J> Find(std::string ref,const std::string& key) {
L000108:         while(!ref.empty()) { const auto node=Node(ref); const auto k=node.at("k").get<std::string>();
L000109:             if(key==k) return std::optional<nlohmann::json>{node.at("v")}; ref=node.at(key<k?"l":"r").get<std::string>(); }
L000110:         return {};
L000111:     }
L000112:     std::string Erase(const std::string& ref,const std::string& key) {
L000113:         if(ref.empty()) return ref;
L000114:         const auto node=Node(ref); const auto k=node.at("k").get<std::string>();
L000115:         if(key<k) return Balance(k,node.at("v"),Erase(node.at("l"),key),node.at("r"));
L000116:         if(key>k) return Balance(k,node.at("v"),node.at("l"),Erase(node.at("r"),key));
L000117:         if(node.at("l")=="") return node.at("r");
L000118:         if(node.at("r")=="") return node.at("l");
L000119:         auto successor=Node(node.at("r"));
L000120:         while(successor.at("l")!="") successor=Node(successor.at("l"));
L000121:         return Balance(successor.at("k"),successor.at("v"),node.at("l"),Erase(node.at("r"),successor.at("k")));
L000122:     }
L000123:     void Keys(const std::string& ref,std::set<std::string>& keys) {
L000124:         if(ref.empty()) return;
L000125:         const auto node=Node(ref); keys.insert(node.at("k")); Keys(node.at("l"),keys); Keys(node.at("r"),keys);
L000126:     }
L000127:     std::string Build(const std::vector<std::pair<std::string,J>>& items,std::size_t lo,std::size_t hi) {
L000128:         if(lo==hi) return "";
L000129:         const auto mid=lo+(hi-lo)/2;
L000130:         return Make(items[mid].first,items[mid].second,Build(items,lo,mid),Build(items,mid+1,hi));
L000131:     }
L000132:     void Values(const std::string& ref,J& values) {
L000133:         if(ref.empty()) return;
L000134:         const auto node=Node(ref); Values(node.at("l"),values); values.push_back(Decode(node.at("v"))); Values(node.at("r"),values);
L000135:     }
L000136:     static std::string Ordinal(std::size_t index) {
L000137:         auto key=std::to_string(index); return std::string(20-key.size(),'0')+key;
L000138:     }
L000139: public:
L000140:     explicit SharedJson(State& state):state_(state) {}
L000141:     J Encode(const J& value,bool evidence=false,const std::optional<J>& previous={}) {
L000142:         if(value.is_array()) {
L000143:             if(previous && previous->is_object() && previous->contains("$avl") && previous->at("keyed")==evidence) {
L000144:                 auto root=previous->at("$avl").get<std::string>();
L000145:                 // 快速路径：上一版序列解码后与新值相等（逐元素 json ==，与下面差分里的 != 判据相同），
L000146:                 // 差分路径不会 Put、也不会 Erase，根必然不变，直接返回同样的结果，省掉逐边 Find。
L000147:                 if(value.size()>=kMemoMinItems && !root.empty()) {
L000148:                     auto& memo=M(); const auto found=memo.decoded.find(MemoKey(root));
L000149:                     if(found!=memo.decoded.end() && found->second==value)
L000150:                         return {{"$avl",root},{"count",value.size()},{"keyed",evidence}};
L000151:                 }
L000152:                 std::set<std::string> removed; Keys(root,removed);
L000153:                 for(std::size_t i=0;i<value.size();++i) {
L000154:                     const auto key=evidence?value[i].at("observation_id").get<std::string>():Ordinal(i);
L000155:                     const auto old=Find(root,key); const auto encoded=Encode(value[i],false,old);
L000156:                     if(!old || *old!=encoded) root=Put(root,key,encoded);
L000157:                     removed.erase(key);
L000158:                 }
L000159:                 for(const auto& key:removed) root=Erase(root,key);
L000160:                 return {{"$avl",root},{"count",value.size()},{"keyed",evidence}};
L000161:             }
L000162:             // 快速路径：完全相同的序列（dump 逐字节相同，区分 1 与 1.0、0.0 与 -0.0）从零构建过，
L000163:             // 而对象库只增不改，再次 Build 的每个 Intern 都会命中同一键，根必然相同。
L000164:             std::string built_key;
L000165:             if(value.size()>=kMemoMinItems) {
L000166:                 try { built_key=MemoKey(std::string(evidence?"K":"O")+value.dump()); }
L000167:                 catch(const J::exception&) { built_key.clear(); }   // 非法 UTF-8：交给原路径按原样报错
L000168:                 if(!built_key.empty()) {
L000169:                     auto& memo=M(); const auto found=memo.built.find(built_key);
L000170:                     if(found!=memo.built.end()) return {{"$avl",found->second},{"count",value.size()},{"keyed",evidence}};
L000171:                 }
L000172:             }
L000173:             std::vector<std::pair<std::string,J>> items; items.reserve(value.size());
L000174:             for(std::size_t i=0;i<value.size();++i)
L000175:                 items.emplace_back(evidence?value[i].at("observation_id").get<std::string>():Ordinal(i),Encode(value[i]));
L000176:             if(evidence) std::sort(items.begin(),items.end(),[](const auto& a,const auto& b){return a.first<b.first;});
L000177:             auto root=Build(items,0,items.size());
L000178:             if(!built_key.empty()) { auto& memo=M(); Remember(memo.built,memo.built_order,built_key,root); }
L000179:             return {{"$avl",root},{"count",items.size()},{"keyed",evidence}};
L000180:         }
L000181:         if(value.is_object()) { J result=J::object();
L000182:             for(auto it=value.begin();it!=value.end();++it) result[it.key()]=Encode(it.value(),it.key()=="evidence",
L000183:                 previous && previous->is_object() && previous->contains(it.key())?std::optional<J>(previous->at(it.key())):std::nullopt);
L000184:             return result;
L000185:         }
L000186:         return value;
L000187:     }
L000188:     J Decode(const J& value) {
L000189:         if(value.is_object() && value.contains("$avl")) {
L000190:             const auto root=value.at("$avl").get<std::string>();
L000191:             // 只在 count 为合法无符号数且足够大时备忘；其余情况完全走原路径（含原有的报错顺序）。
L000192:             const auto count=value.find("count");
L000193:             std::string key;
L000194:             if(!root.empty() && count!=value.end() && count->is_number_unsigned() &&
L000195:                count->get<std::size_t>()>=kMemoMinItems) {
L000196:                 key=MemoKey(root);
L000197:                 auto& memo=M(); const auto found=memo.decoded.find(key);
L000198:                 if(found!=memo.decoded.end()) {
L000199:                     if(found->second.size()!=Count(value)) throw std::runtime_error("shared trajectory sequence count mismatch");
L000200:                     return found->second;
L000201:                 }
L000202:             }
L000203:             J result=J::array(); Values(root,result);
L000204:             if(result.size()!=Count(value)) throw std::runtime_error("shared trajectory sequence count mismatch");
L000205:             if(!key.empty()) { auto& memo=M(); Remember(memo.decoded,memo.decoded_order,key,result); }
L000206:             return result;
L000207:         }
L000208:         if(value.is_object()) { J result=J::object(); for(auto it=value.begin();it!=value.end();++it) result[it.key()]=Decode(it.value()); return result; }
L000209:         return value;
L000210:     }
L000211:     static std::size_t Count(const J& sequence) { return sequence.at("count").get<std::size_t>(); }
L000212:     J At(const J& sequence,std::size_t index) {
L000213:         if(sequence.at("keyed").get<bool>() || index>=Count(sequence)) throw std::out_of_range("shared sequence index");
L000214:         const auto value=Find(sequence.at("$avl"),Ordinal(index));
L000215:         if(!value) throw std::runtime_error("missing shared sequence entry"); return *value;
L000216:     }
L000217:     void Set(J& sequence,std::size_t index,const J& encoded) {
L000218:         if(sequence.at("keyed").get<bool>() || index>Count(sequence)) throw std::out_of_range("shared sequence index");
L000219:         sequence["$avl"]=Put(sequence.at("$avl"),Ordinal(index),encoded);
L000220:         if(index==Count(sequence)) sequence["count"]=index+1;
L000221:     }
L000222:     void Append(J& sequence,const J& value) { Set(sequence,Count(sequence),Encode(value)); }
L000223:     void InsertEvidence(J& sequence,const J& evidence) {
L000224:         const auto key=evidence.at("observation_id").get<std::string>();
L000225:         if(!sequence.at("keyed").get<bool>() || Find(sequence.at("$avl"),key)) throw std::logic_error("append proof reused an existing observation");
L000226:         sequence["$avl"]=Put(sequence.at("$avl"),key,Encode(evidence)); sequence["count"]=Count(sequence)+1;
L000227:     }
L000228: };
L000229: }

L000262: void ActivityStore::Notify(const json& r,const json& response,State& scope) {
L000263:     if(!Event(r) || response.value("duplicate",false) || response.value("status","")=="EXPIRED")return;
L000264:     const bool camera_events=CameraEventsMode(Context(r.at("activity_id")));
L000265:     if(camera_events && (r.at("op")!="monitoring_observe" || !response.contains("camera_event") || !response.at("camera_event").is_object()))return;
L000266:     auto seq=std::stoull(scope.Get("activity_result_meta","sequence").value_or("0"))+1;
L000267:     // Notification is a compact committed algorithm result, independent of
L000268:     // backend delivery acknowledgements. Full trajectory history stays queried.
L000269:     json e={{"sequence",seq},{"operation",r.at("op")},{"status",response.value("status","")},
L000270:         {"retention_deadline_unix_ms",response.at("retention_deadline_unix_ms")}};
L000271:     for(const auto* k:{"activity_id","activity_num","venue_id","config_version","binding_version","monitoring_version","route_rule_id"})
L000272:         if(response.contains(k))e[k]=response.at(k);
L000273:     if(camera_events) {
L000274:         e["output_mode"]="UE_CAMERA_EVENTS";e["camera_event"]=response.at("camera_event");
L000275:     } else for(const auto* k:{"association","monitoring","reason_codes"})
L000276:         if(response.contains(k))e[k]=response.at(k);
L000277:     // Nested monitoring may contain session history; retention removes results
L000278:     // whenever their activity's dependent evidence is pruned.
L000279:     std::ostringstream key;key<<std::setfill('0')<<std::setw(20)<<seq;
L000280:     scope.Put("activity_result",key.str(),e.dump());
L000281:     scope.Put("activity_result_meta","sequence",std::to_string(seq));
L000282: }

L000067: AssociationPolicy CheckedPolicy(AssociationPolicy p) {
L000068:     const auto unit = [](double v) { return std::isfinite(v) && v >= 0 && v <= 1; };
L000069:     if (p.policy_id.empty() || !unit(p.new_target_threshold) || !unit(p.match_threshold) ||
L000070:         p.new_target_threshold >= p.match_threshold || !unit(p.template_update_threshold) ||
L000071:         p.template_update_threshold < p.match_threshold || !unit(p.max_template_similarity) ||
L000072:         p.max_template_similarity < p.template_update_threshold || !std::isfinite(p.min_margin) ||
L000073:         p.min_margin < 0 || p.min_margin > 2 || !unit(p.min_detection_score) ||
L000074:         !std::isfinite(p.min_face_size_px) || p.min_face_size_px <= 0 ||
L000075:         p.max_clock_uncertainty_ms < 0 || p.max_templates_per_target == 0) {
L000076:         throw std::invalid_argument("invalid association policy");
L000077:     }
L000078:     for (auto& pair : p.overlapping_cameras) {

L000083:     std::sort(p.overlapping_cameras.begin(), p.overlapping_cameras.end());

L000085:                                 p.overlapping_cameras.end());

L000125:     auto j=nlohmann::json::array();for(const auto& t:found->second)j.push_back({{"observation_id",t.observation_id},{"template_id",t.template_id},{"quality",t.quality}});
L000126:     state_->Put("owned_template",target,j.dump());

L000128: void AssociationStore::SaveRecord(const Record& record) {
L000129:     // Derive changes before overwriting the observation or its revision. This
L000130:     // upgrades legacy indices lazily within the same transaction.
L000131:     const auto previous = state_ ? LoadRecord(record.observation.observation_id) : std::optional<Record>{};
L000132:     std::map<std::string, TargetSummary> summaries;
L000133:     if (state_) {
L000134:         for (const auto& target : record.result.affected_target_ids)
L000135:             summaries.emplace(target, EnsureTargetIndex(target));
L000136:         if (previous && previous->result.target_id && !summaries.count(*previous->result.target_id))
L000137:             summaries.emplace(*previous->result.target_id, EnsureTargetIndex(*previous->result.target_id));
L000138:         const auto old_target = previous ? previous->result.target_id : std::optional<std::string>{};
L000139:         const auto& new_target = record.result.target_id;
L000140:         if (old_target != new_target) {
L000141:             if (old_target) {
L000142:                 auto& counts = summaries.at(*old_target).camera_counts;
L000143:                 auto found = counts.find(previous->observation.camera_id);
L000144:                 if (found == counts.end() || !found->second)
L000145:                     throw std::logic_error("association camera index is inconsistent");
L000146:                 if (--found->second == 0) counts.erase(found);
L000147:             }
L000148:             if (new_target) ++summaries.at(*new_target).camera_counts[record.observation.camera_id];
L000149:             if (!record.observation.local_track_id.empty()) {
L000150:                 const auto track = TrackIndexKey(record.observation);
L000151:                 auto counts = TrackTargetCounts(track);
L000152:                 if (old_target) {
L000153:                     auto found = counts.find(*old_target);
L000154:                     if (found == counts.end() || !found->second)
L000155:                         throw std::logic_error("association track index is inconsistent");
L000156:                     if (--found->second == 0) counts.erase(found);
L000157:                 }
L000158:                 if (new_target) ++counts[*new_target];
L000159:                 state_->Put("association_track_targets",track,
L000160:                     nlohmann::json({{"schema_version",1},{"counts",counts}}).dump());
L000161:             }
L000162:         }
L000163:         if (new_target) {
L000164:             const auto& o = record.observation;
L000165:             state_->Put("association_frame",o.observation_id,
L000166:                 nlohmann::json::array({o.track_session_id,o.local_track_id}).dump(),
L000167:                 *new_target,FrameIndexKey(*new_target,o));
L000168:         } else if (old_target) state_->Erase("association_frame",record.observation.observation_id);
L000169:     }
L000170:     for (const auto& target : record.result.affected_target_ids) {
L000171:         if (state_) state_->Put("association_target_revision", target, std::to_string(record.result.version));
L000172:         else target_revisions_[target] = record.result.version;
L000173:     }
L000174:     if(!state_){records_.insert_or_assign(record.observation.observation_id,record);return;}
L000175:     const auto& o=record.observation;
L000176:     const auto track=nlohmann::json::array({o.source_id,o.camera_id,o.track_session_id,o.local_track_id}).dump();
L000177:     auto meta=nlohmann::json(o);meta.erase("embedding");meta.erase("feature_space");
L000178:     // Metadata includes the sighting but never the 512D vector.
L000179:     meta["sighting"]=record.result.sighting;meta["target_id"]=record.result.target_id;
L000180:     state_->Put("observation",o.observation_id,nlohmann::json({{"observation",o},{"result",record.result}}).dump(),
L000181:         record.result.target_id.value_or(""),track,meta.dump());
L000182:     for (auto& [target, summary] : summaries) {
L000183:         summary.revision = TargetRevision(target);
L000184:         SaveTargetSummary(target,summary);
L000185:     }
L000186:     state_->Put("version","association",std::to_string(version_));
L000187: }

L000195: AssociationStore::TargetSummary AssociationStore::EnsureTargetIndex(const std::string& target) const {
L000196:     const auto revision = TargetRevision(target);
L000197:     if (const auto stored = state_->Get("association_target_summary",target)) {
L000198:         const auto value = nlohmann::json::parse(*stored);
L000199:         if (value.value("schema_version",0)==1 && value.at("revision").get<std::uint64_t>()==revision)
L000200:             return {revision,value.at("camera_counts").get<std::map<std::string,std::uint64_t>>()};
L000201:     }
L000202:     TargetSummary summary{revision,{}};
L000203:     // Remove stale derived rows, never authoritative observation history.
L000204:     std::vector<std::string> stale;

L000206:     for (const auto& id : stale) state_->Erase("association_frame",id);
L000207:     for (const auto& o : TargetMetadata(target)) {
L000208:         ++summary.camera_counts[o.camera_id];

L000210:             nlohmann::json::array({o.track_session_id,o.local_track_id}).dump(),target,FrameIndexKey(target,o));
L000211:     }
L000212:     SaveTargetSummary(target,summary);

L000243: 
L000244: CameraCompatibility AssociationStore::Compatible(const FaceObservation& o, const std::string& target,
L000245:                                                   const AssociationPolicy& policy, const CameraGraph& graph) const {
L000246:     if (state_) {
L000247:         const auto summary = EnsureTargetIndex(target);
L000248:         if (summary.camera_counts.empty()) return CameraCompatibility::Compatible;
L000249:         if (summary.camera_counts.size()==1 && summary.camera_counts.begin()->first==o.camera_id) {
L000250:             bool conflict=false;
L000251:             state_->Scan("association_frame",[&](const std::string&,const std::string& text){
L000252:                 const auto track=nlohmann::json::parse(text);
L000253:                 if (o.local_track_id.empty() || track.at(1).get<std::string>().empty() ||
L000254:                     track.at(0)!=o.track_session_id || track.at(1)!=o.local_track_id) conflict=true;
L000255:             },{},false,FrameIndexKey(target,o));
L000256:             // CheckCaptureChain makes exactly this same-camera conclusion,
L000257:             // after applying the original same-source/frame collision rule.
L000258:             return conflict ? CameraCompatibility::Conflict : CameraCompatibility::Compatible;
L000259:         }
L000260:     }
L000261:     const auto history = TargetMetadata(target);
L000262:     if (history.empty()) return CameraCompatibility::Compatible;
L000263:     std::vector<CaptureInterval> captures{{o.camera_id,Lower(o),Upper(o)}};
L000264:     for (const auto& old : history) {
L000265:         if (o.camera_id == old.camera_id) {
L000266:             // Two different face observations in one source frame cannot be one person.
L000267:             if (o.source_id == old.source_id && o.frame_id == old.frame_id &&
L000268:                 (o.local_track_id.empty() || old.local_track_id.empty() || Track(o) != Track(old))) {
L000269:                 return CameraCompatibility::Conflict;
L000270:             }
L000271:         }
L000272:         captures.push_back({old.camera_id,Lower(old),Upper(old)});
L000273:     }
L000274:     switch (CheckCaptureChain(std::move(captures),graph,policy.overlapping_cameras,policy.topology_is_complete)) {
L000275:         case ChainFeasibility::Feasible: return CameraCompatibility::Compatible;
L000276:         case ChainFeasibility::Infeasible: return CameraCompatibility::Conflict;
L000277:         default:return CameraCompatibility::Unknown;
L000278:     }
L000279: }

L000281: void AssociationStore::ForgetTemplate(const std::string& observation_id, const std::string& target) {
L000282:     auto owner=templates_.find(target);if(owner==templates_.end())return;
L000283:     auto& entries = owner->second;
L000284:     const auto found = std::find_if(entries.begin(), entries.end(), [&](const auto& t) {
L000285:         return t.observation_id == observation_id;
L000286:     });
L000287:     if (found != entries.end()) {
L000288:         gallery_.Remove(found->template_id);
L000289:         entries.erase(found);
L000290:         SaveTemplates(target);
L000291:     }
L000292: }

L000294: void AssociationStore::Assign(Record& record, const std::string& target, const std::string& evidence,
L000295:                               const AssociationPolicy& policy, bool update_template) {
L000296:     auto& result = record.result;
L000297:     const auto& o = record.observation;
L000298:     const auto owner=templates_.find(target);
L000299:     auto entries=owner==templates_.end()?std::vector<OwnedTemplate>{}:owner->second;
L000300:     const auto by_quality = [](const auto& a, const auto& b) { return a.quality < b.quality; };
L000301:     while (entries.size() > policy.max_templates_per_target) {
L000302:         const auto worst = std::min_element(entries.begin(), entries.end(), by_quality);
L000303:         gallery_.Remove(worst->template_id);
L000304:         entries.erase(worst);
L000305:     }
L000306:     if (update_template) {
L000307:         const auto quality = o.detection_score * o.face_size_px;
L000308:         const auto worst = std::min_element(entries.begin(), entries.end(), by_quality);
L000309:         if (entries.size() < policy.max_templates_per_target || quality > worst->quality) {
L000310:             const auto template_id = "assoc-template:" + o.observation_id;
L000311:             if (entries.size() >= policy.max_templates_per_target) {
L000312:                 gallery_.Remove(worst->template_id);
L000313:                 entries.erase(worst);
L000314:             }
L000315:             gallery_.Add({template_id, target, o.feature_space, o.embedding});
L000316:             entries.push_back({o.observation_id, template_id, quality});
L000317:             result.template_added = true;
L000318:         }
L000319:     }
L000320:     if (result.target_id && *result.target_id != target) {
L000321:         const auto old = *result.target_id;
L000322:         if(!state_)target_observations_[old].erase(o.observation_id);
L000323:         ForgetTemplate(o.observation_id, old);
L000324:         result.affected_target_ids.push_back(old);
L000325:     }
L000326:     result.target_id = target;
L000327:     result.sighting = SightingEvidence{o.observation_id, target, o.camera_id, evidence,
L000328:         o.captured_at_unix_ms, o.clock_uncertainty_ms, TargetLinkStatus::Confirmed,
L000329:         o.time_source, o.source_id, o.clock_domain, o.reentry_evidence_id};
L000330:     if(!state_) {
L000331:         target_observations_[target].insert(o.observation_id);
L000332:         if (!o.local_track_id.empty()) track_observations_[Track(o)].insert(o.observation_id);
L000333:     }
L000334:     templates_.insert_or_assign(target,std::move(entries));
L000335:     SaveTemplates(target);
L000336:     if(state_)state_->Put("association_target",target,"1");
L000337:     result.affected_target_ids.push_back(target);
L000338:     // Read track identity from accepted records so corrections cannot leave stale bindings.
L000339: }

L000341: AssociationResult AssociationStore::Observe(FaceObservation observation, const AssociationPolicy& input_policy,
L000342:                                             const CameraGraph& input_graph, bool reconsider) {
L000343:     last_append_.reset();
L000344:     const auto policy = CheckedPolicy(input_policy);
L000345:     const auto graph = NormalizeCameraGraph(input_graph);
L000346:     const auto& o = observation;
L000347:     if (o.observation_id.empty() || o.source_id.empty() || o.camera_id.empty() || o.frame_id.empty() ||
L000348:         o.clock_domain.empty() || (o.local_track_id.empty() != o.track_session_id.empty()) ||
L000349:         !std::isfinite(o.detection_score) || o.detection_score < 0 || o.detection_score > 1 ||
L000350:         !std::isfinite(o.face_size_px) || o.face_size_px <= 0) {
L000351:         throw std::invalid_argument("invalid face observation metadata");
L000352:     }
L000353:     const auto known_policy = policies_.find(policy.policy_id);
L000354:     if (known_policy != policies_.end() && PolicyKey(known_policy->second) != PolicyKey(policy))
L000355:         throw std::invalid_argument("association policy changed without a new policy_id");
L000356:     const auto known_graph = graphs_.find(graph.version);
L000357:     if (known_graph != graphs_.end() && !SameGraph(known_graph->second, graph))
L000358:         throw std::invalid_argument("camera graph changed without a new version");
L000359:     const auto previous = LoadRecord(o.observation_id);
L000360:     if (previous) {
L000361:         if (!SameObservation(previous->observation, o))
L000362:             throw std::invalid_argument("conflicting duplicate observation_id");
L000363:         if (!reconsider || previous->result.target_id) return previous->result;
L000364:     }
L000365:     std::optional<std::uint64_t> append_previous_target_revision;
L000366:     // Decisions consider every person in the feature space; a TopK cutoff can hide the
L000367:     // runner-up after camera filtering. The gallery also validates the contract and vector.
L000368:     Gallery::ValidateQuery(o.feature_space,o.embedding);
L000369:     Record next{std::move(observation), {}};
L000370:     auto& result = next.result;
L000371:     result.observation_id = next.observation.observation_id;
L000372:     result.policy_id = policy.policy_id;
L000373:     result.graph_version = graph.version;
L000374:     const auto& current = next.observation;
L000375:     std::vector<PersonHit> hits;
L000376:     if (!UsableTime(current, policy)) {
L000377:         result.decision = "UNASSIGNED";
L000378:         result.reason = "capture time is not qualified UTC evidence";
L000379:     } else if (!UsableFace(current, policy)) {
L000380:         result.decision = "UNASSIGNED";
L000381:         result.reason = "face does not pass configured detection and size gates";
L000382:     } else {
L000383:         std::vector<AssociationCandidate> eligible;
L000384:         // 返回 true 表示按下列规则提前结束；false 表示把 hits 全部看完了。
L000385:         const auto classify = [&]() {
L000386:             for (const auto& hit : hits) {
L000387:                 // Sorted lower scores cannot alter a decision once both feasible
L000388:                 // leaders are known and the visual Top8 has been classified.
L000389:                 if (result.candidates.size()>=8 && eligible.size()>=2) return true;
L000390:                 if (result.candidates.size()>=8 && eligible.empty() && hit.similarity<policy.new_target_threshold) return true;
L000391:                 if(result.candidates.size()>=8 && eligible.size()==1 &&
L000392:                     (eligible[0].hit.similarity<policy.match_threshold ||
L000393:                      eligible[0].hit.similarity-hit.similarity>=policy.min_margin)) {
L000394:                     result.remaining_similarity_upper_bound=hit.similarity;
L000395:                     return true;
L000396:                 }
L000397:                 const auto compatibility = Compatible(current, hit.person_entity_id, policy, graph);
L000398:                 AssociationCandidate candidate{hit, compatibility};
L000399:                 if (result.candidates.size() < 8) result.candidates.push_back(candidate);
L000400:                 if (compatibility != CameraCompatibility::Conflict)
L000401:                     eligible.push_back(candidate);
L000402:             }
L000403:             return false;
L000404:         };
L000405:         // 先取前 kFirstPage 名（与全量排序的前缀完全相同）。绝大多数抓拍在前 8～10 名内就能判定；
L000406:         // 只有这一页看完仍未判定、且可能还有更多人时，才退回全量检索并从头重判，结论与原实现一致。
L000407:         constexpr std::size_t kFirstPage = 64;
L000408:         hits = gallery_.Search(current.feature_space, current.embedding, kFirstPage);
L000409:         if (!classify() && hits.size() == kFirstPage) {
L000410:             result.candidates.clear();
L000411:             eligible.clear();
L000412:             result.remaining_similarity_upper_bound.reset();
L000413:             hits = gallery_.Search(current.feature_space, current.embedding, std::numeric_limits<std::size_t>::max());
L000414:             classify();
L000415:         }
L000416:         // Keep the visual Top8 and the decision's feasible winner/runner-up.
L000417:         for (std::size_t i = 0; i < std::min<std::size_t>(2, eligible.size()); ++i) {
L000418:             if (std::none_of(result.candidates.begin(), result.candidates.end(), [&](const auto& c) {
L000419:                     return c.hit.person_entity_id == eligible[i].hit.person_entity_id;
L000420:                 })) result.candidates.push_back(eligible[i]);
L000421:         }
L000422:         std::set<std::string> track_targets;
L000423:         if (!current.local_track_id.empty()) {
L000424:             if(state_) {
L000425:                 for (const auto& [target,count] : TrackTargetCounts(TrackIndexKey(current)))
L000426:                     if (count) track_targets.insert(target);
L000427:             } else {
L000428:             const auto track = track_observations_.find(Track(current));
L000429:             if (track != track_observations_.end()) {
L000430:                 for (const auto& id : track->second) track_targets.insert(*records_.at(id).result.target_id);
L000431:             }
L000432:             }
L000433:         }
L000434:         if (!eligible.empty() && eligible[0].hit.similarity >= policy.match_threshold &&
L000435:             (eligible.size() == 1 || eligible[0].hit.similarity - eligible[1].hit.similarity >= policy.min_margin)) {
L000436:             const auto& best = eligible[0];
L000437:             if ((!track_targets.empty() && (track_targets.size() != 1 || !track_targets.count(best.hit.person_entity_id)))) {
L000438:                 result.decision = "CONFLICT";
L000439:                 result.reason = "local track identity disagrees with face evidence";
L000440:             } else if ((policy.require_topology || policy.topology_is_complete) && best.compatibility == CameraCompatibility::Unknown) {
L000441:                 result.decision = "PROVISIONAL";
L000442:                 result.reason = "joint capture feasibility could not be established from topology or within solve budget";
L000443:             } else {
L000444:                 result.decision = "MATCHED";
L000445:                 result.reason = "face margin and available camera constraints passed";
L000446:                 if (!previous) append_previous_target_revision=TargetRevision(best.hit.person_entity_id);
L000447:                 Assign(next, best.hit.person_entity_id, "association:" + current.observation_id, policy,
L000448:                        best.hit.similarity >= policy.template_update_threshold &&
L000449:                        best.hit.similarity < policy.max_template_similarity);
L000450:             }
L000451:         } else if (hits.empty() || hits[0].similarity < policy.new_target_threshold) {
L000452:             if (!track_targets.empty()) {
L000453:                 result.decision = "CONFLICT";
L000454:                 result.reason = "local track face no longer supports its accepted identity";
L000455:             } else {
L000456:                 result.decision = "CREATED";
L000457:                 result.reason = "no similar identity in the compatible feature space";
L000458:                 const auto target = "auto:" + ActivityStore::Digest(nlohmann::json::array({
L000459:                     state_?state_->Scope():std::string{},current.source_id,current.observation_id}).dump());
L000460:                 if (!previous) append_previous_target_revision=TargetRevision(target);
L000461:                 Assign(next, target, "association:" + current.observation_id, policy, true);
L000462:             }
L000463:         } else {
L000464:             const bool conflict = eligible.empty() || eligible[0].hit.similarity < policy.new_target_threshold;
L000465:             result.decision = conflict ? "CONFLICT" : "PROVISIONAL";
L000466:             result.reason = conflict ? "similar faces conflict with camera evidence"
L000467:                                              : "face score or person margin is inconclusive";
L000468:         }
L000469:     }
L000470:     result.version = ++version_;
L000471:     const bool new_policy=policies_.emplace(policy.policy_id, policy).second;
L000472:     const bool new_graph=graphs_.emplace(graph.version, graph).second;
L000473:     if(state_){if(new_policy)state_->Put("policy",policy.policy_id,nlohmann::json(policy).dump());if(new_graph)state_->Put("association_graph",graph.version,nlohmann::json(graph).dump());}
L000474:     const auto id = current.observation_id;
L000475:     const bool append = !previous && append_previous_target_revision && result.sighting && result.target_id &&
L000476:         result.affected_target_ids.size()==1 && result.affected_target_ids.front()==*result.target_id;
L000477:     SaveRecord(next);
L000478:     if (append) last_append_=AssociationAppend{*result.sighting,*append_previous_target_revision,TargetRevision(*result.target_id)};
L000479:     return next.result;
L000480: }
L000481: 
L000482: AssociationResult AssociationStore::Correct(const std::string& observation_id, const std::string& target,
L000483:                                             const std::string& evidence) {
L000484:     last_append_.reset();
L000485:     if (target.empty() || evidence.empty()) throw std::invalid_argument("target and correction evidence are required");
L000486:     auto loaded=LoadRecord(observation_id);
L000487:     if(!loaded)throw std::out_of_range("observation not found");
L000488:     auto& record=*loaded;
L000489:     const auto& policy = policies_.at(record.result.policy_id);
L000490:     if (!UsableTime(record.observation, policy) || !UsableFace(record.observation, policy))
L000491:         throw std::invalid_argument("correction cannot manufacture qualified face/capture evidence");

L000051: // Proleptic Gregorian civil date to days since 1970-01-01. No host timezone or
L000052: // time_t dependency; years before 1970 keep their signed millisecond value.
L000053: Millis Days(int year, unsigned month, unsigned day) {
L000054:     year -= month <= 2;
L000055:     const auto era = year / 400;
L000056:     const auto yoe = static_cast<unsigned>(year - era * 400);
L000057:     const auto shifted_month = month > 2 ? month - 3 : month + 9;
L000058:     const auto doy = (153 * shifted_month + 2) / 5 + day - 1;
L000059:     const auto doe = yoe * 365 + yoe / 4 - yoe / 100 + doy;
L000060:     return static_cast<Millis>(era) * 146097 + doe - 719468;
L000061: }

L000063: ParsedTime Parse(const std::string& text, const json& profile) {
L000064:     if (text.size() < 19 || text.size() > 32 || text[4] != '-' || text[7] != '-' ||

L000072:             result = result * 10 + text[i] - '0';

L000077:     const auto hour = digits(11, 2), minute = digits(14, 2), second = digits(17, 2);
L000078:     const bool leap = year % 4 == 0 && (year % 100 != 0 || year % 400 == 0);
L000079:     const int month_days[] = {31, leap ? 29 : 28, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31, 31, 30, 31, 30, 31};
L000080:     if (year < 1 || month < 1 || month > 12 || day < 1 || day > month_days[month - 1] ||

L000200:             const auto first = Integer(calibration, "valid_from_utc_ms"), last = Integer(calibration, "valid_until_utc_ms");

L000204:                                    std::max(Integer(calibration, "time_resolution_ms"), parsed.resolution_ms) - 1);

L000053: void Normalize(Embedding& value) {

L000055:     for (float component : value) {
L000056:         if (!std::isfinite(component)) {
L000057:             throw std::invalid_argument("embedding must contain finite values");
L000058:         }
L000059:         squared_norm += static_cast<double>(component) * component;
L000060:     }

L000062:         throw std::invalid_argument("embedding must have nonzero finite norm");
L000063:     }

L000070: float DotSse2OrScalar(const Embedding& left, const Embedding& right) {
L000071: #if defined(_M_X64) || defined(__SSE2__)
L000072:     // Float inputs, double products/accumulation. Do not lower precision near
L000073:     // identity thresholds to obtain a faster benchmark.
L000074:     __m128d a=_mm_setzero_pd(),b=a;
L000075:     for(std::size_t i=0;i<kEmbeddingDim;i+=4){
L000076:         const auto l=_mm_loadu_ps(left.data()+i),r=_mm_loadu_ps(right.data()+i);
L000077:         a=_mm_add_pd(a,_mm_mul_pd(_mm_cvtps_pd(l),_mm_cvtps_pd(r)));
L000078:         b=_mm_add_pd(b,_mm_mul_pd(_mm_cvtps_pd(_mm_movehl_ps(l,l)),_mm_cvtps_pd(_mm_movehl_ps(r,r))));
L000079:     }
L000080:     double lanes[2];_mm_storeu_pd(lanes,_mm_add_pd(a,b));
L000081:     return static_cast<float>(lanes[0]+lanes[1]);
L000082: #else
L000083:     double sum = 0;
L000084:     for (std::size_t i = 0; i < kEmbeddingDim; ++i) {
L000085:         sum += static_cast<double>(left[i]) * right[i];
L000086:     }
L000087:     return static_cast<float>(sum);
L000088: #endif
L000089: }
L000090: 
L000091: #if defined(__GNUC__) && (defined(__x86_64__) || defined(__i386__))
L000092: // 同一套双精度运算的 AVX 版：4 个双精度通道依次对应 SSE2 版的 a0、a1、b0、b1，
L000093: // 每个通道的乘、加顺序与 SSE2 版完全相同，收尾也按 (a0+b0)+(a1+b1) 合并，因此结果逐位一致。
L000094: // 只开 avx、不开 fma：融合乘加会改变舍入，不能用它换速度。
L000095: __attribute__((target("avx"))) float DotAvx(const Embedding& left, const Embedding& right) {
L000096:     __m256d acc = _mm256_setzero_pd();
L000097:     for (std::size_t i = 0; i < kEmbeddingDim; i += 4) {
L000098:         const __m256d l = _mm256_cvtps_pd(_mm_loadu_ps(left.data() + i));
L000099:         const __m256d r = _mm256_cvtps_pd(_mm_loadu_ps(right.data() + i));
L000100:         acc = _mm256_add_pd(acc, _mm256_mul_pd(l, r));
L000101:     }
L000102:     double lanes[4];
L000103:     _mm256_storeu_pd(lanes, acc);
L000104:     return static_cast<float>((lanes[0] + lanes[2]) + (lanes[1] + lanes[3]));
L000105: }
L000106: const bool kHasAvx = [] { __builtin_cpu_init(); return __builtin_cpu_supports("avx") != 0; }();
L000107: #endif
L000108: 
L000109: float Dot(const Embedding& left, const Embedding& right) {
L000110: #if defined(__GNUC__) && (defined(__x86_64__) || defined(__i386__))
L000111:     if (kHasAvx) return DotAvx(left, right);
L000112: #endif
L000113:     return DotSse2OrScalar(left, right);
L000114: }

L000116: // 检索线程上限：默认 8（原行为）；与其他业务共用服务器时用 FACE_TRAJECTORY_SEARCH_THREADS 调小（1–64）。
L000117: // 线程数只影响耗时，不影响得分和排序结果。
L000118: int SearchThreads() {
L000119:     static const int value = [] {
L000120:         const char* text = std::getenv("FACE_TRAJECTORY_SEARCH_THREADS");
L000121:         if (!text || !*text) return 8;
L000122:         char* end = nullptr;
L000123:         const long parsed = std::strtol(text, &end, 10);
L000124:         return (end && *end == '\0' && parsed >= 1 && parsed <= 64) ? static_cast<int>(parsed) : 8;
L000125:     }();
L000126:     return value;
L000127: }

L000161: void Gallery::Add(FaceTemplate value) {
L000162:     if (value.template_id.empty() || value.person_entity_id.empty()) {
L000163:         throw std::invalid_argument("template and person IDs are required");
L000164:     }
L000165:     value.feature_space = CanonicalizeSpace(std::move(value.feature_space));
L000166:     Normalize(value.embedding);
L000167:     std::unique_lock lock(mutex_);
L000168:     if (template_spaces_.find(value.template_id) != template_spaces_.end()) {
L000169:         throw std::invalid_argument("duplicate template_id");
L000170:     }
L000171:     if(template_spaces_.size()>=max_templates_)throw std::runtime_error("CAPACITY: gallery template limit reached");
L000172:     const auto id = value.template_id;
L000173:     const auto space = value.feature_space;
L000174:     if (state_) state_->Put("template",id,nlohmann::json(value).dump());
L000175:     template_spaces_.emplace(id, space);
L000176:     try {
L000177:         auto& bucket=templates_by_space_[space];
L000178:         auto person=bucket.person_slots.find(value.person_entity_id);
L000179:         std::size_t slot;
L000180:         if(person!=bucket.person_slots.end())slot=person->second;
L000181:         else {
L000182:             if(bucket.free_person_slots.empty()){slot=bucket.persons.size();bucket.persons.push_back({value.person_entity_id,0});}
L000183:             else {slot=bucket.free_person_slots.back();bucket.free_person_slots.pop_back();bucket.persons[slot]={value.person_entity_id,0};}
L000184:             bucket.person_slots.emplace(value.person_entity_id,slot);
L000185:         }
L000186:         bucket.rows.push_back({value.template_id,slot,value.embedding});
L000187:         ++bucket.persons[slot].count;
L000188:         bucket.slots.emplace(id,bucket.rows.size()-1);
L000189:     } catch (...) {
L000190:         template_spaces_.erase(id);
L000191:         throw;
L000192:     }
L000193:     ++version_;
L000194:     if(state_)state_->Put("version","gallery",std::to_string(version_));
L000195: }

L000197: void Gallery::Remove(const std::string& template_id) {
L000198:     std::unique_lock lock(mutex_);
L000199:     const auto index = template_spaces_.find(template_id);
L000200:     if (index == template_spaces_.end()) {
L000201:         throw std::invalid_argument("unknown template_id");
L000202:     }
L000203:     auto bucket = templates_by_space_.find(index->second);
L000204:     auto& rows=bucket->second.rows;
L000205:     const auto slot=bucket->second.slots.at(template_id);
L000206:     auto& person=bucket->second.persons[rows[slot].person_slot];
L000207:     if(--person.count==0){bucket->second.person_slots.erase(person.id);person.id.clear();bucket->second.free_person_slots.push_back(rows[slot].person_slot);}
L000208:     if(slot+1!=rows.size()) { rows[slot]=std::move(rows.back());bucket->second.slots.at(rows[slot].template_id)=slot; }
L000209:     rows.pop_back();bucket->second.slots.erase(template_id);
L000210:     if (rows.empty()) templates_by_space_.erase(bucket);
L000211:     template_spaces_.erase(index);
L000212:     if(state_)state_->Erase("template",template_id);
L000213:     ++version_;
L000214:     if(state_)state_->Put("version","gallery",std::to_string(version_));
L000215: }
L000216: 
L000217: std::vector<PersonHit> Gallery::Search(
L000218:     const FeatureSpaceContract& feature_space, const Embedding& query, std::size_t top_k) const {
L000219:     const auto normalized_space = CanonicalizeSpace(feature_space);
L000220:     if (top_k == 0) throw std::invalid_argument("positive top_k is required");
L000221:     Embedding normalized_query = query;
L000222:     Normalize(normalized_query);
L000223:     std::shared_lock lock(mutex_);
L000224:     std::vector<PersonHit> hits;
L000225:     const auto bucket = templates_by_space_.find(normalized_space);
L000226:     if (bucket != templates_by_space_.end()) {
L000227:         const auto& rows=bucket->second.rows;
L000228:         const auto& persons=bucket->second.persons;
L000229:         std::vector<float> scores(rows.size());
L000230: #ifdef _OPENMP
L000231:         const int threads=std::max(1,std::min(SearchThreads(),omp_get_num_procs()));
L000232: #pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) num_threads(threads) if(rows.size()>=10000 && threads>1)
L000233: #endif
L000234:         for(std::int64_t i=0;i<static_cast<std::int64_t>(rows.size());++i)
L000235:             scores[static_cast<std::size_t>(i)]=Dot(normalized_query,rows[static_cast<std::size_t>(i)].embedding);
L000236:         std::vector<std::optional<std::size_t>> best(persons.size());
L000237:         for (std::size_t slot=0;slot<rows.size();++slot) {
L000238:             const auto& value=rows[slot];
L000239:             const auto& id=value.template_id;
L000240:             const float score = scores[slot];
L000241:             auto& winner=best[value.person_slot];
L000242:             if (!winner || score > scores[*winner] ||
L000243:                 (score == scores[*winner] && id < rows[*winner].template_id)) {
L000244:                 winner=slot;
L000245:             }
L000246:         }
L000247:         // 先只按 (得分, 人员槽位) 排名，最后只为前 top_k 名复制人员/模板 ID 字符串；
L000248:         // 排名规则与原实现相同（得分降序，同分按人员 ID 升序），因此前 top_k 名完全一致。
L000249:         std::vector<std::size_t> ranked;
L000250:         ranked.reserve(bucket->second.person_slots.size());
L000251:         for(std::size_t i=0;i<best.size();++i)if(best[i])ranked.push_back(i);
L000252:         const auto better_slot=[&](std::size_t a,std::size_t b){
L000253:             const float sa=scores[*best[a]],sb=scores[*best[b]];
L000254:             if(sa!=sb)return sa>sb;
L000255:             return persons[a].id<persons[b].id;
L000256:         };
L000257:         if(ranked.size()>top_k){
L000258:             std::nth_element(ranked.begin(),ranked.begin()+static_cast<std::ptrdiff_t>(top_k),ranked.end(),better_slot);
L000259:             ranked.resize(top_k);
L000260:         }
L000261:         std::sort(ranked.begin(),ranked.end(),better_slot);
L000262:         hits.reserve(ranked.size());
L000263:         for(const auto i:ranked)hits.push_back({persons[i].id,rows[*best[i]].template_id,scores[*best[i]]});
L000264:     }
L000265:     return hits;
L000266: }

L000087:         // row; do not leave a stale review bubble after it becomes confirmed.

L000089:             current && (current->sighting || current->target_id)) return;
L000090:         const auto normalization = response.value("normalization", json::object());
L000091:         if (before && normalization.contains("captured_at_unix_ms") &&
L000092:             normalization.at("captured_at_unix_ms").is_number_integer() &&
L000093:             normalization.at("captured_at_unix_ms").template get<std::int64_t>() >= *before) return;
L000094:         const auto policy = payload.value("policy", json::object());
L000095:         bool quality_passed = false;
L000096:         if (observation.contains("detection_score") && observation.contains("face_size_px") &&
L000097:             policy.contains("min_detection_score") && policy.contains("min_face_size_px")) {
L000098:             quality_passed = observation.at("detection_score").is_number() &&
L000099:                 observation.at("face_size_px").is_number() &&
L000100:                 observation.at("detection_score").template get<double>() >= policy.at("min_detection_score").template get<double>() &&
L000101:                 observation.at("face_size_px").template get<double>() >= policy.at("min_face_size_px").template get<double>();
L000102:         } else {
L000103:             quality_passed = association.value("decision", "") != "UNASSIGNED";
L000104:         }
L000105:         json top1 = nullptr;
L000106:         if (!candidates.empty() && candidates.front().contains("similarity"))
L000107:             top1 = candidates.front().at("similarity");
L000108:         auto reasons = response.value("reason_codes", json::array());
L000109:         std::string hold_reason;
L000110:         if (reasons.is_array() && !reasons.empty() && reasons.front().is_string())
L000111:             hold_reason = reasons.front().template get<std::string>();
L000112:         if (hold_reason.empty()) hold_reason = association.value("reason", "HOLD");
L000113:         const auto captured = normalization.contains("captured_at_unix_ms")
L000114:             ? normalization.at("captured_at_unix_ms") : json(nullptr);
L000115:         result.push_back({
L000116:             {"observation_id", observation_id},
L000117:             {"source_id", observation.value("source_id", "")},
L000118:             {"camera_id", observation.value("camera_id", "")},
L000119:             {"captured_at_unix_ms", captured},
L000120:             {"hold_reason", hold_reason},
L000121:             {"status_reason", association.value("reason", hold_reason)},
L000122:             {"top1_similarity", top1},
L000123:             {"quality_passed", quality_passed},
L000124:             {"status", "HOLD"},
L000125:             {"included_in_confirmed_trajectory", false}
L000126:         });
L000127:     });
L000128:     std::sort(result.begin(), result.end(), [](const auto& a, const auto& b) {
L000129:         const auto at = a.at("captured_at_unix_ms").is_number_integer()
L000130:             ? a.at("captured_at_unix_ms").template get<std::int64_t>() : std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::max();
L000131:         const auto bt = b.at("captured_at_unix_ms").is_number_integer()
L000132:             ? b.at("captured_at_unix_ms").template get<std::int64_t>() : std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::max();
L000133:         return std::tie(at, a.at("observation_id").template get_ref<const std::string&>()) <
L000134:             std::tie(bt, b.at("observation_id").template get_ref<const std::string&>());
L000135:     });
L000136:     return result;
L000137: }
L000138: }

L000151: json MonitoringStore::PhotoUrl(const json& value) {
L000152:     if(value.is_null())return nullptr;
L000153:     if(!value.is_string())throw std::invalid_argument("photo URL must be an absolute HTTP(S) URL or null");
L000154:     const auto url=value.get<std::string>();
L000155:     const auto separator=url.find("://");
L000156:     auto scheme=url.substr(0,separator);
L000157:     std::transform(scheme.begin(),scheme.end(),scheme.begin(),[](unsigned char c){return static_cast<char>(std::tolower(c));});
L000158:     if(url.size()>4096 || separator==std::string::npos || (scheme!="https" && scheme!="http") ||
L000159:        std::any_of(url.begin(),url.end(),[](unsigned char c){return c<=32 || c==127 || c=='\\';}))
L000160:         throw std::invalid_argument("photo URL must be an absolute HTTP(S) URL without whitespace, limited to 4096 bytes");
L000161:     const auto start=separator+3,end=url.find_first_of("/?#",start);
L000162:     const auto authority=url.substr(start,end==std::string::npos?end:end-start);
L000163:     if(authority.empty() || authority.find('@')!=std::string::npos)
L000164:         throw std::invalid_argument("photo URL requires a host and must not contain user credentials");
L000165:     std::string host,port;
L000166:     if(authority.front()=='[') {
L000167:         const auto close=authority.find(']');
L000168:         if(close==std::string::npos || close<=1 || authority.substr(1,close-1).find(':')==std::string::npos)
L000169:             throw std::invalid_argument("photo URL has an invalid bracketed host");
L000170:         host=authority.substr(0,close+1);
L000171:         if(close+1<authority.size()) {
L000172:             if(authority[close+1]!=':')throw std::invalid_argument("photo URL has an invalid host/port");
L000173:             port=authority.substr(close+2);
L000174:             if(port.empty())throw std::invalid_argument("photo URL port must be numeric");
L000175:         }
L000176:     } else {
L000177:         const auto colon=authority.find(':');
L000178:         host=authority.substr(0,colon);
L000179:         if(colon!=std::string::npos) {
L000180:             port=authority.substr(colon+1);
L000181:             if(port.empty())throw std::invalid_argument("photo URL port must be numeric");
L000182:         }
L000183:         if(host.find_first_of("[]")!=std::string::npos)
L000184:             throw std::invalid_argument("photo URL has an invalid host");
L000185:     }
L000186:     if(host.empty() || (!port.empty() && (port.size()>5 ||
L000187:        !std::all_of(port.begin(),port.end(),[](unsigned char c){return c>='0' && c<='9';}) || std::stoul(port)>65535)))
L000188:         throw std::invalid_argument("photo URL requires a nonempty host and a valid port");
L000189:     return value;
L000190: }

L000199: json MonitoringStore::CameraTimeline(const json& request,const AssociationStore& associations,const json& context) const {
L000200:     RequireDurable();
L000201:     if(!ActivityStore::CameraEventsMode(context))
L000202:         throw std::invalid_argument("SOURCE_CONFLICT: named camera timeline requires UE_CAMERA_EVENTS");
L000203:     const auto timestamp=[](const json& object,const char* field)->std::int64_t {
L000204:         const auto& v=object.at(field);
L000205:         if(!v.is_number_integer() || (v.is_number_unsigned() && v.get<std::uint64_t>()>static_cast<std::uint64_t>(std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::max())) ||
L000206:            (!v.is_number_unsigned() && v.get<std::int64_t>()<0))
L000207:             throw std::invalid_argument(std::string(field)+" must be nonnegative UTC milliseconds within int64");
L000208:         return v.get<std::int64_t>();
L000209:     };
L000210:     const auto target=Required(request,"person_id");
L000211:     const auto from=timestamp(request,"from_unix_ms"),to=timestamp(request,"to_unix_ms");
L000212:     if(from>=to)throw std::invalid_argument("from_unix_ms must precede to_unix_ms (end exclusive)");
L000213:     const auto limit=request.contains("limit")?Revision(request,"limit"):500;
L000214:     if(limit<1 || limit>1000)throw std::invalid_argument("timeline limit must be within 1..1000");
L000215:     const auto revision=associations.TargetRevision(target);
L000216:     if(request.contains("expected_association_revision") && Revision(request,"expected_association_revision")!=revision)
L000217:         throw std::invalid_argument("VERSION_CONFLICT: appearance timeline changed; restart pagination");
L000218:     const auto now=timestamp(request.at("_trusted_clock"),"now_unix_ms");
L000219:     const auto effective_from=std::max(from,now-ActivityStore::RetentionMs);
L000220:     using Order=std::tuple<std::int64_t,std::string,std::string>;
L000221:     const auto identity=[](const SightingEvidence& s) {
L000222:         auto source=s.source_id,id=s.observation_id;
L000223:         const auto parsed=json::parse(id,nullptr,false);
L000224:         if(parsed.is_array() && parsed.size()==2 && parsed[0].is_string() && parsed[1].is_string()) {
L000225:             source=parsed[0].get<std::string>();id=parsed[1].get<std::string>();
L000226:         }
L000227:         return std::make_pair(source,id);
L000228:     };
L000229:     const auto order=[&](const SightingEvidence& s) {
L000230:         const auto key=identity(s);return Order{s.captured_at_unix_ms,key.first,key.second};
L000231:     };
L000232:     std::optional<Order> after;
L000233:     if(request.contains("after")) {
L000234:         const auto& c=request.at("after");
L000235:         if(!c.is_object())throw std::invalid_argument("after must be a timeline cursor object");
L000236:         if(!request.contains("expected_association_revision"))
L000237:             throw std::invalid_argument("expected_association_revision is required with after");
L000238:         after=Order{timestamp(c,"captured_at_unix_ms"),Required(c,"source_id"),Required(c,"observation_id")};
L000239:     }
L000240:     std::vector<SightingEvidence> sightings;
L000241:     if(revision) {
L000242:         try{sightings=associations.Sightings(target);}catch(const std::out_of_range&){}
L000243:     }
L000244:     sightings.erase(std::remove_if(sightings.begin(),sightings.end(),[&](const auto& s) {
L000245:         return s.captured_at_unix_ms<effective_from || s.captured_at_unix_ms>=to ||
L000246:             s.link_status!=TargetLinkStatus::Confirmed || s.time_source!=TimeSource::UtcCapture || s.clock_domain!="UTC" ||
L000247:             s.clock_uncertainty_ms<0 || s.clock_uncertainty_ms>60000 || (after && order(s)<=*after);
L000248:     }),sightings.end());
L000249:     std::sort(sightings.begin(),sightings.end(),[&](const auto& a,const auto& b){return order(a)<order(b);});
L000250:     const bool more=sightings.size()>limit;
L000251:     if(more)sightings.resize(static_cast<std::size_t>(limit));
L000252:     auto timeline=json::array();
L000253:     for(const auto& s:sightings) {
L000254:         const auto key=identity(s);
L000255:         json name=nullptr,photo=nullptr;std::string name_source="UNAVAILABLE";
L000256:         if(const auto saved=state_->Get("monitoring_observation",s.observation_id)) {
L000257:             const auto record=ObservationRecord(state_,*saved,false);
L000258:             const auto event=record.at("response").value("camera_event",json(nullptr));
L000259:             if(event.is_object() && event.value("camera_id",std::string{})==s.camera_id &&
L000260:                event.value("captured_at_unix_ms",std::int64_t{-1})==s.captured_at_unix_ms && event.contains("camera_name")) {
L000261:                 name=event.at("camera_name");name_source="CAPTURE_EVENT";
L000262:                 photo=event.value("capture_photo_url",json(nullptr));
L000263:             }
L000264:             // A HOLD receipt never acquires a camera_event when identity is
L000265:             // later corrected. The immutable observation still owns its photo.
L000266:             if(photo.is_null()) {
L000267:                 const auto full=ObservationRecord(state_,*saved,true);
L000268:                 const auto observation=full.value("payload",json::object()).value("observation",json::object());
L000269:                 if(observation.value("camera_id",std::string{})==s.camera_id) {
L000270:                     try{photo=PhotoUrl(observation.value("capture_photo_url",json(nullptr)));}
L000271:                     catch(const std::invalid_argument&){} // Legacy unvalidated metadata is unavailable.
L000272:                 }
L000273:             }
L000274:         }
L000275:         if(name.is_null())for(const auto& b:context.value("bindings",json::array())) {
L000276:             if(b.at("kind")=="CAMERA" && b.at("source_id")==key.first && b.at("device_id")==s.camera_id && b.contains("camera_name")) {
L000277:                 name=b.at("camera_name");name_source="CURRENT_ACTIVITY_BINDING";break;
L000278:             }
L000279:         }
L000280:         timeline.push_back({{"camera_id",s.camera_id},{"camera_name",name},{"camera_name_source",name_source},
L000281:             {"capture_photo_url",photo},
L000282:             {"captured_at_unix_ms",s.captured_at_unix_ms},{"clock_uncertainty_ms",s.clock_uncertainty_ms},
L000283:             {"source_id",key.first},{"observation_id",s.observation_id}});
L000284:     }
L000285:     json next=nullptr;
L000286:     if(more && !timeline.empty()) {
L000287:         const auto& last=timeline.back();next={{"captured_at_unix_ms",last.at("captured_at_unix_ms")},
L000288:             {"source_id",last.at("source_id")},{"observation_id",last.at("observation_id")}};
L000289:     }
L000290:     const auto person=Person(target);
L000291:     return {{"ok",true},{"person_id",target},{"category",person.at("category")},{"is_priority",person.at("category")=="PRIORITY"},
L000292:         {"person",PersonSummary(target)},{"person_revision",person.at("revision")},{"association_revision",revision},{"from_unix_ms",from},{"to_unix_ms",to},
L000293:         {"effective_from_unix_ms",effective_from},{"history_pruned",effective_from>from},{"order_basis","CAPTURE_TIME_NOMINAL"},
L000294:         {"timeline",timeline},{"count",timeline.size()},{"has_more",more},{"next_after",next}};
L000295: }

L000596: void MonitoringStore::CheckpointRuntime(std::int64_t cutoff,const AssociationStore& associations) {
L000597:     std::set<std::string> targets;
L000598:     state_->Scan("association_target",[&](const auto& id,const auto&){targets.insert(id);});
L000599:     state_->Scan("monitoring_runtime",[&](const auto& id,const auto&){targets.insert(id);});
L000600:     for(const auto& target:targets) {
L000601:         const auto complete=Get(target,associations);
L000602:         auto p=Get(target,associations,cutoff);
L000603:         auto dependencies=json::array();
L000604:         for(const auto& group:complete.at("event_groups")) {
L000605:             bool old_positive=group.value("pruned_positive",false),old_exit=group.value("pruned_exit",false);
L000606:             for(const auto& event:group.at("events")) {
L000607:                 const auto lower=event.at("earliest_unix_ms").get<std::int64_t>(),upper=event.at("latest_unix_ms").get<std::int64_t>();
L000608:                 if(lower+(upper-lower)/2<cutoff){old_exit|=event.at("kind")=="EXIT";old_positive|=event.at("kind")!="EXIT";}
L000609:             }
L000610:             if(!old_positive&&!old_exit)continue;
L000611:             for(const auto& event:group.at("events")) {
L000612:                 const auto lower=event.at("earliest_unix_ms").get<std::int64_t>(),upper=event.at("latest_unix_ms").get<std::int64_t>();
L000613:                 if(lower+(upper-lower)/2>=cutoff)dependencies.push_back({{"event_hash",ActivityStore::Digest(event.at("event_id").get<std::string>())},{"pruned_positive",old_positive},{"pruned_exit",old_exit}});
L000614:             }
L000615:         }
L000616:         if(p.at("status")=="NOT_STARTED"&&dependencies.empty())continue;
L000617:         json seed={{"status",p.at("status")},{"entry_status","UNKNOWN"},{"session_id",nullptr},{"boundary_ambiguous",false}};
L000618:         seed["boundary_dependencies"]=dependencies;
L000619:         if(!p.at("sessions").empty()){const auto& s=p.at("sessions").back();seed["session_id"]=s.at("session_id");seed["entry_status"]=s.at("entry_status");seed["boundary_ambiguous"]=s.at("boundary_ambiguous");}
L000620:         // No historical time, camera, event key or passage sequence survives.
L000621:         state_->Put("monitoring_runtime",target,seed.dump());
L000622:     }
L000623: }

L000298: json One(const std::string& configured,std::int64_t now,bool dry_run,const ClockAdapter& clocks,const ExpiredReference& external) {
L000299:     const auto path=std::filesystem::weakly_canonical(std::filesystem::absolute(std::filesystem::u8path(configured)));
L000300:     json result={{"path",PathToUtf8(path)},{"dry_run",dry_run},{"status","ERROR"}};
L000301:     if(!std::filesystem::is_regular_file(path)){result["reason"]="CONFIGURED_P1_FILE_MISSING";return result;}
L000302:     // Read-only inventory never creates a lease file or a tombstone table.
L000303:     std::unique_ptr<Lease> owner,lease;
L000304:     std::unique_ptr<PauseRequest> pause;
L000305:     if(!dry_run) {
L000306:         owner=std::make_unique<Lease>(path,".maintenance.lock");
L000307:         if(!owner->held){result["status"]="BLOCKED_OTHER_MAINTENANCE";return result;}
L000308:         pause=std::make_unique<PauseRequest>(path);
L000309:         const auto deadline=std::chrono::steady_clock::now()+std::chrono::seconds(20);
L000310:         do {
L000311:             lease=std::make_unique<Lease>(path);
L000312:             if(lease->held)break;
L000313:             lease.reset();std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(50));
L000314:         } while(std::chrono::steady_clock::now()<deadline);
L000315:         if(!lease||!lease->held){result["status"]="BLOCKED_P1_QUIESCENCE";result["pause_wait_limit_ms"]=20000;return result;}
L000316:         result["pause_handshake"]="QUIESCENT";

L000318:     }
L000319:     Database database(PathToUtf8(path),dry_run);auto db=database.db;
L000320:     if(!dry_run)Sql(db,"PRAGMA secure_delete=ON");
L000321:     Sql(db,dry_run?"BEGIN":"BEGIN IMMEDIATE");
L000322:     try {
L000323:         result["before"]=Stats(db,path);
L000324:         auto rows=Inventory(db,clocks,now);json tables=json::object();
L000325:         std::set<std::string> expired_keys;
L000326:         for(const auto& row:rows)if(row.expired&&(row.table=="deliveries"||row.table=="outbox"))expired_keys.insert(row.key);
L000327:         std::uint64_t expired=0,known=0,unknown=0,enrolled=0,retained=0;
L000328:         for(const auto& row:rows) {
L000329:             auto& stats=tables[row.table];if(stats.is_null())stats={{"before_rows",0},{"retained_rows",0},{"expired_known_rows",0},{"expired_unknown_rows",0},{"excluded_enrollment_rows",0}};
L000330:             stats["before_rows"]=stats.at("before_rows").get<std::uint64_t>()+1;
L000331:             const auto field=row.enrolled?"excluded_enrollment_rows":!row.expired?"retained_rows":row.known?"expired_known_rows":"expired_unknown_rows";
L000332:             stats[field]=stats.at(field).get<std::uint64_t>()+1;
L000333:             if(row.enrolled)++enrolled;else if(!row.expired)++retained;else {++expired;if(row.known)++known;else ++unknown;}
L000334:         }
L000335:         result["tables"]=tables;result["expired_rows"]=expired;result["expired_known_rows"]=known;
L000336:         result["expired_unknown_rows"]=unknown;result["retained_window_rows"]=retained;result["excluded_enrollment_rows"]=enrolled;
L000337:         result["unknown_policy"]="IMMEDIATE_EXPIRY_WITH_HASH_TOMBSTONE_NO_NEW_WINDOW";
L000338:         std::uint64_t dependencies=0;
L000339:         for(auto& row:rows)if(!row.expired&&!row.enrolled&&row.data.is_object()) {
L000340:             auto expired_reference=[&](const std::string& activity,const std::string& source,const std::string& event){return HasExpired(db,expired_keys,external,activity,source,event);};
L000341:             if(!ScrubReferences(row.data,ContextString(row.data,"activity_id",{}),ContextString(row.data,"source_id",{}),expired_reference))continue;
L000342:             ++dependencies;
L000343:             if(!dry_run) {
L000344:                 const auto column=row.table=="captures"||row.table=="frames"?"metadata":"payload";
L000345:                 // Preserve the original content hash for identical retry/conflict.
L000346:                 // A changed pending body cannot be resent under the original ID.
L000347:                 const auto status=Columns(db,row.table).count("status")?",status=CASE WHEN status='PENDING' THEN 'QUARANTINED' ELSE status END":"";

L000349:                 update.Bind(1,row.data.dump());update.Bind(2,row.key);update.Step();

L000351:         }
L000352:         result["scrubbed_expired_dependency_rows"]=dependencies;

L000354:             Sql(db,"CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS retention_tombstone(table_name TEXT NOT NULL,key_hash TEXT NOT NULL,content_hash TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(table_name,key_hash)) WITHOUT ROWID");
L000355:             for(const auto& row:rows)if(row.expired) {
L000356:                 Statement tombstone(db,"INSERT INTO retention_tombstone(table_name,key_hash,content_hash) VALUES(?,?,?) ON CONFLICT(table_name,key_hash) DO NOTHING");
L000357:                 tombstone.Bind(1,row.table);tombstone.Bind(2,ActivityStore::Digest(row.key));tombstone.Bind(3,row.hash);tombstone.Step();
L000358:                 Statement erase(db,"DELETE FROM "+row.table+" WHERE id=?");erase.Bind(1,row.key);erase.Step();
L000359:             }
L000360:             // Receipts are historical transaction snapshots. Canonical current
L000361:             // state is queried from P2; retaining an old receipt can retain points
L000362:             // from before this delivery's own capture. Enrollment is excluded.
L000363:             std::uint64_t scrubbed=0;
L000364:             for(const auto* table:{"deliveries","outbox"}) {
L000365:                 auto columns=Columns(db,table);if(!columns.count("receipt"))continue;
L000366:                 const auto predicate=columns.count("route")?" AND route<>'/v1/monitoring/persons'":"";
L000367:                 Sql(db,std::string("UPDATE ")+table+" SET receipt=NULL WHERE receipt IS NOT NULL"+predicate);
L000368:                 scrubbed+=static_cast<std::uint64_t>(sqlite3_changes(db));
L000369:             }
L000370:             // A processed capture report may refer to a deleted observation or
L000371:             // contain a legacy embedded result. Images and metadata in the valid
L000372:             // capture window remain intact; current results come from P2.
L000373:             auto columns=Columns(db,"captures");
L000374:             if(columns.count("result")) {
L000375:                 const auto predicate=columns.count("status")?"status='PROCESSED' AND ":"";
L000376:                 Sql(db,std::string("UPDATE captures SET result=NULL WHERE ")+predicate+"result IS NOT NULL");
L000377:                 scrubbed+=static_cast<std::uint64_t>(sqlite3_changes(db));
L000378:             }
L000379:             result["scrubbed_historical_receipts"]=scrubbed;
L000380:             result["tombstones"]=Scalar(db,"SELECT count(*) FROM retention_tombstone");
L000381:         }
L000382:         // Once committing starts, any later error must leave P1 paused until
L000383:         // another run verifies both physical cleanup and marker removal.
L000384:         if(!dry_run)pause->keep=true;
L000385:         Sql(db,"COMMIT");
L000386:         if(!dry_run) {

L000388:             // A crash after commit must remain paused until another maintenance
L000389:             // run completes the physical sweep; stale pages may still exist.
L000390:             pause->Set("PHYSICAL_CLEANUP_PENDING");
L000391:             // secure_delete only zeros pages freed by this connection. Earlier
L000392:             // image/result updates may have freed pages before it was enabled.
L000393:             // VACUUM rebuilds only reachable rows and removes those old bytes.
L000394:             bool compacted=true;

L000396:             catch(const std::exception& error){compacted=false;result["vacuum_status"]="PENDING_READERS_OR_WRITER";result["vacuum_error"]=error.what();}
L000397:             int log=0,checkpointed=0;const auto checkpoint=sqlite3_wal_checkpoint_v2(db,nullptr,SQLITE_CHECKPOINT_TRUNCATE,&log,&checkpointed);
L000398:             result["checkpoint_status"]=checkpoint==SQLITE_OK?"COMPLETE":"PENDING_READERS";
L000399:             result["checkpoint_log_frames"]=log;result["checkpointed_frames"]=checkpointed;
L000400:             result["status"]=checkpoint==SQLITE_OK&&compacted?"CLEANED":"PHYSICAL_CLEANUP_PENDING";
L000401:         } else result["status"]="DRY_RUN";
L000402:         result["after"]=Stats(db,path);
L000403:         if(!dry_run&&result.at("status")=="CLEANED") {

L000405:             // still keep the Python runtime paused. Both leases remain held.
L000406:             pause->Complete();result["maintenance_request_status"]="CLEARED";
L000407:         }

L000409:     } catch(...) {sqlite3_exec(db,"ROLLBACK",nullptr,nullptr,nullptr);throw;}

L000412: json PruneP1(const std::vector<std::string>& paths,std::int64_t now,bool dry_run,const ClockAdapter& clocks,const ExpiredReference& expired_reference) {
L000413:     if(now<ActivityStore::RetentionMs)throw std::invalid_argument("trusted UTC is required for P1 retention");
L000414:     json databases=json::array();std::set<std::string> seen;bool complete=true;
L000415:     std::vector<std::string> resolved_paths;
L000416:     for(const auto& path:paths)resolved_paths.push_back(PathToUtf8(std::filesystem::weakly_canonical(std::filesystem::absolute(std::filesystem::u8path(path)))));
L000417:     for(const auto& resolved:resolved_paths) {
L000418:         if(!seen.insert(resolved).second)continue;
L000419:         const auto lookup=[&](const std::string& activity,const std::string& source,const std::string& event){
L000420:             if(expired_reference&&expired_reference(activity,source,event))return true;
L000421:             for(const auto& other:resolved_paths)if(other!=resolved&&ExternalExpired(other,activity,source,event,clocks,now))return true;
L000422:             return false;
L000423:         };
L000424:         try {auto result=One(resolved,now,dry_run,clocks,lookup);complete=complete&&(result.at("status")=="CLEANED"||result.at("status")=="DRY_RUN");databases.push_back(std::move(result));}
L000425:         catch(const std::exception& error){complete=false;databases.push_back({{"path",resolved},{"status","ERROR"},{"reason",error.what()}});}
L000426:     }
L000427:     return {{"status",complete?"COMPLETE":"INCOMPLETE"},{"dry_run",dry_run},{"databases",databases}};
L000428: }
