L000112: std::set<std::string> AmbiguousOrder(const std::vector<const SightingEvidence*>& evidence) {
L000113:     const auto lower = [](const auto* e) {
L000114:         return e->captured_at_unix_ms < std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::min() + e->clock_uncertainty_ms
L000115:             ? std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::min() : e->captured_at_unix_ms - e->clock_uncertainty_ms;
L000116:     };
L000117:     const auto upper = [](const auto* e) {
L000118:         return e->captured_at_unix_ms > std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::max() - e->clock_uncertainty_ms
L000119:             ? std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::max() : e->captured_at_unix_ms + e->clock_uncertainty_ms;
L000120:     };
L000121:     auto intervals = evidence;
L000122:     std::sort(intervals.begin(), intervals.end(), [&](auto a, auto b) {
L000123:         if (lower(a) != lower(b)) return lower(a) < lower(b);
L000124:         return a->observation_id < b->observation_id;
L000125:     });
L000126:     std::set<std::string> ambiguous;
L000127:     for (std::size_t begin = 0; begin < intervals.size();) {
L000128:         auto end = begin + 1;
L000129:         auto latest = upper(intervals[begin]);
L000130:         std::set<std::string> cameras{intervals[begin]->camera_id};
L000131:         while (end < intervals.size() && lower(intervals[end]) <= latest) {
L000132:             latest = std::max(latest, upper(intervals[end]));
L000133:             cameras.insert(intervals[end++]->camera_id);
L000134:         }
L000135:         if (cameras.size() > 1)
L000136:             for (auto i = begin; i < end; ++i) ambiguous.insert(intervals[i]->observation_id);
L000137:         begin = end;
L000138:     }
L000139:     return ambiguous;

L000026: double Distance(const Point& a, const Point& b) {
L000027:     return std::hypot(std::hypot(a[0] - b[0], a[1] - b[1]), a[2] - b[2]);
L000028: }
L000029: Point World(const json& matrix, const Point& p) {
L000030:     Point out{};
L000031:     for (int r = 0; r < 3; ++r) {
L000032:         out[r] = matrix[12 + r].get<double>();

L000034:         if (!std::isfinite(out[r])) throw std::invalid_argument("site world transform overflow");

L000038: // A segment projection preserves heights; it is never interpreted as a walkable edge.
L000039: std::pair<double, Point> Closest(const Point& p, const json& annotation) {
L000040:     const auto& points = annotation.at("points");
L000041:     Point best = ReadPoint(points[0]);
L000042:     double distance = Distance(p, best);
L000043:     const bool closed = annotation.at("shape") == "polygon";
L000044:     for (std::size_t i = 1; i < points.size() + (closed ? 1 : 0); ++i) {
L000045:         auto a = ReadPoint(points[i - 1]), b = ReadPoint(points[i % points.size()]);
L000046:         double dot = 0, norm = 0;
L000047:         for (int d = 0; d < 3; ++d) {dot += (p[d] - a[d]) * (b[d] - a[d]); norm += (b[d] - a[d]) * (b[d] - a[d]);}

L000049:         Point q{}; for (int d = 0; d < 3; ++d) q[d] = a[d] + t * (b[d] - a[d]);
L000050:         const double candidate = Distance(p, q);
L000051:         if (candidate < distance) {distance = candidate; best = q;}
L000052:     }
L000053:     return {distance, best};

L000115: json SiteContextStore::CameraContext(const std::string& version, const std::string& camera_ref,
L000116:                                      const std::string& id_namespace, double radius_m) const {
L000117:     if (camera_ref.empty()) throw std::invalid_argument("camera_ref is required");
L000118:     if (id_namespace != "CAMERA_ID" && id_namespace != "VCL_CHANNEL_ID") throw std::invalid_argument("explicit CAMERA_ID or VCL_CHANNEL_ID namespace required");
L000119:     if (!std::isfinite(radius_m) || radius_m < 0) throw std::invalid_argument("finite nonnegative context radius required");
L000120:     const auto site = Get(version);
L000121:     json result = {{"scene_version", version}, {"model_id", site.at("model_id")}, {"scene_url", site.at("scene_url")},
L000122:         {"calibration_profile", site.at("calibration_profile")}, {"coordinate_frame", site.at("coordinate_frame")},
L000123:         {"world_coordinate_frame", site.at("world_coordinate_frame")}, {"unit", "m"},
L000124:         {"source_evidence_id", site.at("source_evidence_id")}, {"camera_ref", camera_ref}, {"id_namespace", id_namespace},
L000125:         {"person_position_observed", false}, {"navigation_verified", false}, {"candidate_markers", json::array()}, {"status", "UNKNOWN_CAMERA"}};
L000126:     std::set<std::string> matches;
L000127:     for (const auto& c : site.at("cameras")) {
L000128:         const auto& ref = c.at(id_namespace == "CAMERA_ID" ? "camera_id" : "vcl_channel_id");
L000129:         if (ref.is_string() && ref == camera_ref) matches.insert(c.at("camera_id").get<std::string>());
L000130:     }
L000131:     if (matches.empty()) return result;
L000132:     if (matches.size() > 1) {result["status"] = "AMBIGUOUS_DEVICE"; result["camera_candidates"] = matches; return result;}
L000133:     const auto camera_id = *matches.begin(); result["camera_id"] = camera_id;
L000134:     result["status"] = "NO_PUBLISHED_CAMERA_MARKER";
L000135:     std::vector<Point> positions;
L000136:     for (const auto& a : site.at("annotations")) {
L000137:         if (a.at("role") != "CAMERA" || a.at("camera_id") != camera_id || !a.at("visible").get<bool>()) continue;
L000138:         const auto p = ReadPoint(a.at("points")[0]); positions.push_back(p);
L000139:         json marker = a; marker["local_xyz"] = p; marker["world_ecef_xyz"] = World(site.at("to_world_matrix"), p);
L000140:         marker["nearby_annotations"] = json::array();
L000141:         for (const auto& other : site.at("annotations")) {
L000142:             if (other.at("role") == "CAMERA" || !other.at("visible").get<bool>()) continue;
L000143:             const auto nearest = Closest(p, other);
L000144:             if (nearest.first > radius_m) continue;
L000145:             json nearby = other; nearby["distance_to_geometry_m"] = nearest.first;
L000146:             nearby["nearest_local_xyz"] = nearest.second;
L000147:             marker["nearby_annotations"].push_back(std::move(nearby));
L000148:         }
L000149:         auto& nearby = marker["nearby_annotations"];
L000150:         std::sort(nearby.begin(), nearby.end(), [](const auto& x, const auto& y) {
L000151:             if (x.at("distance_to_geometry_m") != y.at("distance_to_geometry_m")) return x.at("distance_to_geometry_m") < y.at("distance_to_geometry_m");
L000152:             return x.at("annotation_id") < y.at("annotation_id");
L000153:         });
L000154:         result["candidate_markers"].push_back(std::move(marker));
L000155:     }
L000156:     if (positions.empty()) return result;
L000157:     double separation = 0;
L000158:     for (const auto& a : positions) for (const auto& b : positions) separation = std::max(separation, Distance(a, b));
L000159:     result["max_marker_separation_m"] = separation;
L000160:     result["status"] = separation > site.at("duplicate_tolerance_m").get<double>() ? "AMBIGUOUS_POSITION" : "BOUND_MARKER";
L000161:     // Never average conflicting annotations or turn a nearby landmark into a
L000162:     // confirmed observation region. The caller retains all source candidates.
L000163:     return result;
L000164: }

L000034:         for (auto& item : statements) if (item.second.stmt) sqlite3_finalize(item.second.stmt);
L000035:         statements.clear();

L000043: std::uint64_t SqliteCacheSizeKb() {
L000044:     // SQLite interprets a negative cache_size as kibibytes. Keep the
L000045:     // environment value positive and bounded before interpolating it into SQL.
L000046:     const char* raw = std::getenv("FACE_TRAJECTORY_SQLITE_CACHE_KB");
L000047:     if (raw == nullptr || *raw == '\0') return kDefaultSqliteCacheKb;
L000048:     const char* first = raw;
L000049:     while (*first != '\0' && std::isspace(static_cast<unsigned char>(*first))) ++first;
L000050:     if (*first == '-') return kDefaultSqliteCacheKb;
L000051: 
L000052:     errno = 0;
L000053:     char* end = nullptr;
L000054:     const auto parsed = std::strtoull(raw, &end, 10);
L000055:     if (errno != 0 || end == raw) return kDefaultSqliteCacheKb;
L000056:     while (*end != '\0' && std::isspace(static_cast<unsigned char>(*end))) ++end;
L000057:     if (*end != '\0' || parsed == 0) return kDefaultSqliteCacheKb;
L000058:     return std::min<std::uint64_t>(parsed, kMaxSqliteCacheKb);
L000059: }

L000061: const char* SqliteSynchronousMode() {
L000062:     // NORMAL is the throughput-oriented WAL default; FULL remains available
L000063:     // for deployments that need the stronger per-transaction sync guarantee.
L000064:     const char* raw = std::getenv("FACE_TRAJECTORY_SQLITE_SYNCHRONOUS");
L000065:     if (raw == nullptr) return "NORMAL";
L000066:     std::string mode(raw);
L000067:     std::transform(mode.begin(), mode.end(), mode.begin(), [](unsigned char c) {
L000068:         return static_cast<char>(std::toupper(c));
L000069:     });
L000070:     if (mode == "FULL") return "FULL";
L000071:     return "NORMAL";
L000072: }

L000074: struct Statement {
L000075:     sqlite3* db;
L000076:     sqlite3_stmt* value = nullptr;
L000077:     detail::StateCache::Entry* entry = nullptr;   // 非空 = 借用缓存语句，析构时归还
L000078:     Statement(detail::StateCache& cache,sqlite3* d,const char* sql):db(d) {
L000079:         auto& cached=cache.statements[sql];

L000081:             if(!cached.stmt && sqlite3_prepare_v2(db,sql,-1,&cached.stmt,nullptr)!=SQLITE_OK) {

L000084:             }

L000086:         }

L000088:         if (sqlite3_prepare_v2(db,sql,-1,&value,nullptr)!=SQLITE_OK) {
L000089:             const std::string message=sqlite3_errmsg(db);

L000092:     }

L000097:         if(entry){sqlite3_reset(value);sqlite3_clear_bindings(value);entry->busy=false;}

L000107:         if (result!=SQLITE_ROW && result!=SQLITE_DONE) throw std::runtime_error(sqlite3_errmsg(db));
L000108:         return result;
L000109:     }

L000304: State::StorageStats State::Stats() const {
L000305:     RequireOwner();
L000306:     StorageStats stats;
L000307:     auto pragma=[&](const char* sql) {
L000308:         Statement s(Caches(),db_,sql);s.Step();
L000309:         return static_cast<std::uint64_t>(sqlite3_column_int64(s.value,0));
L000310:     };
L000311:     stats.page_size=pragma("PRAGMA page_size");
L000312:     stats.page_count=pragma("PRAGMA page_count");
L000313:     stats.freelist_count=pragma("PRAGMA freelist_count");
L000314:     stats.reusable_bytes=stats.page_size*stats.freelist_count;
L000315:     auto file_bytes=[](const std::string& path) {
L000316:         if(path.empty()||path=="-wal"||path=="-shm")return std::uint64_t{0};
L000317:         const auto p=std::filesystem::u8path(path);
L000318:         // Sidecars are legitimately absent before/after checkpointing. Other
L000319:         // failures must be reported rather than claiming a zero-byte file.
L000320:         if(!std::filesystem::exists(p))return std::uint64_t{0};
L000321:         return static_cast<std::uint64_t>(std::filesystem::file_size(p));
L000322:     };
L000323:     stats.main_bytes=file_bytes(path_);
L000324:     stats.wal_bytes=file_bytes(path_+"-wal");
L000325:     stats.shm_bytes=file_bytes(path_+"-shm");
L000326:     Statement s(Caches(),db_,"SELECT ns,count(*),sum(length(CAST(ns AS BLOB))+length(CAST(key AS BLOB))+length(CAST(value AS BLOB))+length(CAST(ref AS BLOB))+length(CAST(track AS BLOB))+length(CAST(meta AS BLOB))) FROM state GROUP BY ns ORDER BY ns");
L000327:     while(s.Step()==SQLITE_ROW) {
L000328:         NamespaceStats entry;
L000329:         entry.rows=static_cast<std::uint64_t>(sqlite3_column_int64(s.value,1));
L000330:         entry.logical_bytes=static_cast<std::uint64_t>(sqlite3_column_int64(s.value,2));
L000331:         stats.rows+=entry.rows;
L000332:         stats.logical_bytes+=entry.logical_bytes;
L000333:         stats.namespaces.emplace(s.Text(0),entry);
L000334:     }
L000335:     return stats;
L000336: }
L000337: State::StorageStats State::Maintenance(bool compact) {
L000338:     RequireOwner();
L000339:     if(transaction_)throw std::logic_error("state maintenance requires a committed transaction");
L000340:     auto checkpoint=[&]() {
L000341:         int log_frames=0, checkpointed_frames=0;
L000342:         const auto result=sqlite3_wal_checkpoint_v2(db_,nullptr,SQLITE_CHECKPOINT_TRUNCATE,
L000343:                                                   &log_frames,&checkpointed_frames);
L000344:         if(result!=SQLITE_OK)throw std::runtime_error(std::string("state WAL checkpoint failed: ")+sqlite3_errmsg(db_));
L000345:     };
L000346:     checkpoint();
L000347:     if(compact) {
L000348:         Sql("VACUUM");
L000349:         checkpoint();
L000350:     }
L000351:     return Stats();
L000352: }

L000008: ChainFeasibility CheckCaptureChain(std::vector<CaptureInterval> captures,
L000009:     const CameraGraph& graph, const std::vector<std::pair<std::string,std::string>>& overlaps,
L000010:     bool complete, std::size_t budget) {
L000011:     if (captures.empty()) return ChainFeasibility::Feasible;
L000012:     std::sort(captures.begin(),captures.end(),[](const auto& a,const auto& b) {
L000013:         return std::tie(a.lower,a.upper,a.camera_id)<std::tie(b.lower,b.upper,b.camera_id);
L000014:     });
L000015:     if (std::all_of(captures.begin(),captures.end(),[&](const auto& c){return c.camera_id==captures[0].camera_id;}))
L000016:         return ChainFeasibility::Feasible;
L000017:     std::map<std::string,std::vector<CameraEdge>> adjacency;
L000018:     std::set<std::string> cameras;
L000019:     for (const auto& e:graph.edges) { adjacency[e.from_camera].push_back(e); cameras.insert(e.from_camera); cameras.insert(e.to_camera); }
L000020:     for (const auto& pair:overlaps) {
L000021:         cameras.insert(pair.first); cameras.insert(pair.second);
L000022:         adjacency[pair.first].push_back({pair.first,pair.second,0,0,0,{},{},""});
L000023:         adjacency[pair.second].push_back({pair.second,pair.first,0,0,0,{},{},""});
L000024:     }
L000025:     for (const auto& c:captures) if (!cameras.count(c.camera_id)) return ChainFeasibility::Unknown;
L000026:     bool exhausted=false;
L000027:     const auto arrive=[&](const std::string& from,const std::string& to,std::int64_t start,std::int64_t end)
L000028:         ->std::optional<std::int64_t> {
L000029:         if (start>end) return {};
L000030:         using Entry=std::pair<std::int64_t,std::string>;
L000031:         std::priority_queue<Entry,std::vector<Entry>,std::greater<Entry>> queue;
L000032:         std::map<std::string,std::int64_t> earliest{{from,start}}; queue.push({start,from});
L000033:         while (!queue.empty()) {
L000034:             auto [at,camera]=queue.top(); queue.pop();
L000035:             if (earliest.at(camera)!=at) continue;
L000036:             if (camera==to) return at;
L000037:             for (const auto& e:adjacency[camera]) {
L000038:                 if (!budget) {exhausted=true;return {}; } --budget;
L000039:                 auto depart=std::max(at,e.open_from_unix_ms.value_or(std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::min()));
L000040:                 if (depart>e.open_until_unix_ms.value_or(std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::max()) ||
L000041:                     depart>std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::max()-e.min_travel_ms) continue;
L000042:                 auto next=depart+e.min_travel_ms;
L000043:                 if (next>end) continue;
L000044:                 auto it=earliest.find(e.to_camera);
L000045:                 if (it==earliest.end() || next<it->second) {earliest[e.to_camera]=next;queue.push({next,e.to_camera});}
L000046:             }
L000047:         }
L000048:         return {};
L000049:     };
L000050:     std::map<std::string,std::int64_t> frontier;
L000051:     for (std::size_t begin=0;begin<captures.size();) {
L000052:         auto end=begin+1; auto upper=captures[begin].upper;
L000053:         while (end<captures.size() && captures[end].lower<=upper) {upper=std::max(upper,captures[end].upper);++end;}
L000054:         auto n=end-begin;
L000055:         const bool same=std::all_of(captures.begin()+begin,captures.begin()+end,[&](const auto& c){return c.camera_id==captures[begin].camera_id;});
L000056:         if (same) {
L000057:             std::optional<std::int64_t> at;
L000058:             if (frontier.empty()) at=captures[begin].lower;
L000059:             for (const auto& [camera,time]:frontier) {
L000060:                 auto t=arrive(camera,captures[begin].camera_id,time,captures[begin].upper);
L000061:                 if (t && (!at || *t<*at)) at=t;
L000062:             }
L000063:             for (auto i=begin;at && i<end;++i) {at=std::max(*at,captures[i].lower);if (*at>captures[i].upper) at.reset();}
L000064:             if (exhausted) return ChainFeasibility::Unknown;
L000065:             if (!at) return complete?ChainFeasibility::Infeasible:ChainFeasibility::Unknown;
L000066:             frontier={{captures[begin].camera_id,*at}};begin=end;continue;
L000067:         }
L000068:         if (n>12) return ChainFeasibility::Unknown;
L000069:         const std::size_t full=(std::size_t{1}<<n)-1;
L000070:         std::vector<std::optional<std::int64_t>> times((full+1)*n);
L000071:         for (std::size_t i=0;i<n;++i) {
L000072:             const auto& c=captures[begin+i]; auto& at=times[(std::size_t{1}<<i)*n+i];
L000073:             if (frontier.empty()) at=c.lower;
L000074:             for (const auto& [camera,time]:frontier) {
L000075:                 auto t=arrive(camera,c.camera_id,time,c.upper);
L000076:                 if (t) {t=std::max(*t,c.lower);if (!at || *t<*at) at=t;}
L000077:             }
L000078:         }
L000079:         for (std::size_t mask=1;mask<=full;++mask) for (std::size_t last=0;last<n;++last) {
L000080:             const auto at=times[mask*n+last]; if (!at) continue;
L000081:             for (std::size_t next=0;next<n;++next) if (!(mask&(std::size_t{1}<<next))) {
L000082:                 if (!budget) return ChainFeasibility::Unknown; --budget;
L000083:                 const auto& c=captures[begin+next];
L000084:                 auto t=arrive(captures[begin+last].camera_id,c.camera_id,*at,c.upper);
L000085:                 if (t) {t=std::max(*t,c.lower);auto& cell=times[(mask|(std::size_t{1}<<next))*n+next];if (!cell || *t<*cell) cell=t;}
L000086:                 if (exhausted) return ChainFeasibility::Unknown;
L000087:             }
L000088:         }
L000089:         frontier.clear();
L000090:         for (std::size_t last=0;last<n;++last) if (times[full*n+last]) {
L000091:             const auto& camera=captures[begin+last].camera_id; const auto at=*times[full*n+last];
L000092:             auto it=frontier.find(camera);if (it==frontier.end() || at<it->second) frontier[camera]=at;
L000093:         }
L000094:         if (exhausted) return ChainFeasibility::Unknown;
L000095:         if (frontier.empty()) return complete?ChainFeasibility::Infeasible:ChainFeasibility::Unknown;
L000096:         begin=end;
L000097:     }
L000098:     return ChainFeasibility::Feasible;
L000099: }

L000052: CameraGraph CanonicalGraph(CameraGraph graph) {
L000053:     if (graph.version.empty()) throw std::invalid_argument("graph version is required");
L000054:     std::set<std::string> edge_ids;
L000055:     for (const auto& edge : graph.edges) {
L000056:         if (edge.from_camera.empty() || edge.to_camera.empty() ||
L000057:             edge.min_travel_ms < 0 || edge.max_travel_ms < edge.min_travel_ms ||
L000058:             !std::isfinite(edge.cost) || edge.cost < 0 ||
L000059:             (edge.open_from_unix_ms && edge.open_until_unix_ms &&
L000060:              *edge.open_from_unix_ms > *edge.open_until_unix_ms)) {
L000061:             throw std::invalid_argument("invalid camera edge");
L000062:         }
L000063:         if (!edge.edge_id.empty() && !edge_ids.insert(edge.edge_id).second) {
L000064:             throw std::invalid_argument("duplicate camera edge_id");
L000065:         }
L000066:     }
L000067:     std::sort(graph.edges.begin(), graph.edges.end(), [](const auto& a, const auto& b) {
L000068:         return EdgeKey(a) < EdgeKey(b);
L000069:     });
L000070:     graph.edges.erase(std::unique(graph.edges.begin(), graph.edges.end(),
L000071:                                   [](const auto& a, const auto& b) {
L000072:                                       return EdgeKey(a) == EdgeKey(b);
L000073:                                   }), graph.edges.end());
L000074:     return graph;
L000075: }

L000119: std::optional<PathCandidate> EvaluatePath(const std::vector<const CameraEdge*>& path,
L000120:                                           const Anchor& from, const Anchor& to,
L000121:                                           double time_weight) {
L000122:     // Search gates the route with conservative endpoints. Timing uses the outer
L000123:     // feasible endpoints so actual traversals are not excluded from the output.
L000124:     const auto start = from.time_bounds.last_earliest_unix_ms;
L000125:     const auto end = to.time_bounds.first_latest_unix_ms;
L000126:     if (end < start) return std::nullopt;
L000127: 
L000128:     std::vector<std::int64_t> earliest(path.size() + 1);
L000129:     std::vector<std::int64_t> latest(path.size() + 1);
L000130:     earliest[0] = start;
L000131:     double edge_cost = 0;
L000132:     long double max_travel = 0;
L000133:     for (std::size_t i = 0; i < path.size(); ++i) {
L000134:         const auto& edge = *path[i];
L000135:         const auto depart = std::max(earliest[i], edge.open_from_unix_ms.value_or(
L000136:             std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::min()));
L000137:         if (depart > edge.open_until_unix_ms.value_or(
L000138:                 std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::max()) ||
L000139:             !Add(depart, edge.min_travel_ms, earliest[i + 1]) || earliest[i + 1] > end) {
L000140:             return std::nullopt;
L000141:         }
L000142:         edge_cost += edge.cost;
L000143:         max_travel += edge.max_travel_ms;
L000144:     }
L000145:     latest.back() = end;
L000146:     for (std::size_t i = path.size(); i-- > 0;) {
L000147:         std::int64_t depart;
L000148:         if (!Subtract(latest[i + 1], path[i]->min_travel_ms, depart)) return std::nullopt;
L000149:         latest[i] = std::min(depart, path[i]->open_until_unix_ms.value_or(
L000150:             std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::max()));
L000151:         if (latest[i] < path[i]->open_from_unix_ms.value_or(
L000152:                 std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::min()) || latest[i] < earliest[i]) {
L000153:             return std::nullopt;
L000154:         }
L000155:     }
L000156: 
L000157:     PathCandidate candidate;
L000158:     candidate.nodes.push_back({from.camera_id, NodeStatus::Observed,
L000159:                                from.time_bounds.first_earliest_unix_ms,
L000160:                                from.time_bounds.last_latest_unix_ms});
L000161:     for (std::size_t i = 0; i < path.size(); ++i) {
L000162:         candidate.edge_ids.push_back(path[i]->edge_id);
L000163:         candidate.edge_time_bounds.push_back({
L000164:             std::max(earliest[i], path[i]->open_from_unix_ms.value_or(
L000165:                 std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::min())), latest[i + 1]});
L000166:         if (i + 1 == path.size()) {
L000167:             candidate.nodes.push_back({to.camera_id, NodeStatus::Observed,
L000168:                                        to.time_bounds.first_earliest_unix_ms,
L000169:                                        to.time_bounds.last_latest_unix_ms});
L000170:         } else {
L000171:             candidate.nodes.push_back({path[i]->to_camera, NodeStatus::Inferred,
L000172:                                        earliest[i + 1], latest[i + 1]});
L000173:         }
L000174:     }
L000175:     const auto available = static_cast<long double>(to.time_bounds.first_earliest_unix_ms) -
L000176:                            static_cast<long double>(from.time_bounds.last_latest_unix_ms);
L000177:     candidate.edge_cost = edge_cost;
L000178:     candidate.time_penalty = static_cast<double>(
L000179:         std::max(0.0L, available - max_travel) / 1000.0L * time_weight);
L000180:     candidate.score = -candidate.edge_cost - candidate.time_penalty;
L000181:     return candidate;
L000182: }

L000194: }

L000196: using CameraAdjacency = std::map<std::string, std::vector<const CameraEdge*>>;
L000197: 
L000198: CameraAdjacency BuildAdjacency(const CameraGraph& graph) {
L000199:     CameraAdjacency adjacency;
L000200:     for (const auto& edge : graph.edges) adjacency[edge.from_camera].push_back(&edge);
L000201:     return adjacency;
L000202: }
L000203: 
L000204: // Reverse Dijkstra gives a lower bound without coordinates or opening windows.
L000205: // Ignoring windows makes the bound optimistic, so pruning cannot remove a route.
L000206: std::map<std::string, std::int64_t> MinimumRemainingTravel(
L000207:     const CameraGraph& graph, const std::string& destination) {
L000208:     CameraAdjacency incoming;
L000209:     for (const auto& edge : graph.edges) incoming[edge.to_camera].push_back(&edge);
L000210:     using Entry = std::pair<std::int64_t, std::string>;
L000211:     std::priority_queue<Entry, std::vector<Entry>, std::greater<Entry>> pending;
L000212:     std::map<std::string, std::int64_t> minimum{{destination, 0}};
L000213:     pending.push({0, destination});
L000214:     while (!pending.empty()) {
L000215:         const auto [distance, camera] = pending.top();
L000216:         pending.pop();
L000217:         if (distance != minimum.at(camera)) continue;
L000218:         for (const auto* edge : incoming[camera]) {
L000219:             std::int64_t next;
L000220:             if (!Add(distance, edge->min_travel_ms, next)) continue;
L000221:             const auto found = minimum.find(edge->from_camera);
L000222:             if (found == minimum.end() || next < found->second) {
L000223:                 minimum[edge->from_camera] = next;
L000224:                 pending.push({next, edge->from_camera});
L000225:             }
L000226:         }
L000227:     }
L000228:     return minimum;
L000229: }
L000230: 
L000231: TrajectorySegment BuildSegment(const Anchor& from, const Anchor& to,
L000232:                                const CameraGraph& graph, const CameraAdjacency& adjacency,
L000233:                                const TrajectoryOptions& options) {
L000234:     const auto from_earliest = from.time_bounds.last_earliest_unix_ms;
L000235:     const auto from_latest = from.time_bounds.last_latest_unix_ms;
L000236:     const auto to_earliest = to.time_bounds.first_earliest_unix_ms;
L000237:     const auto to_latest = to.time_bounds.first_latest_unix_ms;
L000238:     const bool overlapping = to_earliest <= from_latest;
L000239:     TrajectorySegment segment{"segment:" + from.anchor_id + ":" + to.anchor_id,
L000240:                               graph.version,
L000241:                               from.anchor_id, to.anchor_id,
L000242:                               std::min(from_earliest, to_earliest),
L000243:                               std::max(from_latest, to_latest),
L000244:                               NodeStatus::Unknown, true, false, std::nullopt, {}};
L000245:     // Clock-overlapping observation intervals do not establish a movement order.
L000246:     if (overlapping) return segment;
L000247:     const auto minimum_remaining = MinimumRemainingTravel(graph, to.camera_id);
L000248:     std::vector<PathCandidate> found;
L000249:     std::vector<const CameraEdge*> path;
L000250:     std::set<std::string> visited{from.camera_id};
L000251:     std::size_t expansions = 0;
L000252:     bool expansion_limit = false;
L000253:     std::function<void(const std::string&, std::int64_t)> search =
L000254:         [&](const std::string& current, std::int64_t earliest) {
L000255:         auto it = adjacency.find(current);
L000256:         if (it == adjacency.end()) return;
L000257:         for (const auto* edge : it->second) {
L000258:             const bool at_destination = edge->to_camera == to.camera_id;
L000259:             if (!at_destination && visited.count(edge->to_camera)) continue;
L000260:             if (at_destination && edge->to_camera != from.camera_id &&
L000261:                 visited.count(edge->to_camera)) continue;
L000262:             const auto depart = std::max(earliest, edge->open_from_unix_ms.value_or(
L000263:                 std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::min()));
L000264:             std::int64_t arrival;
L000265:             if (depart > edge->open_until_unix_ms.value_or(
L000266:                     std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::max()) ||
L000267:                 !Add(depart, edge->min_travel_ms, arrival) || arrival > to_earliest) {
L000268:                 continue;
L000269:             }
L000270:             const auto remaining = minimum_remaining.find(edge->to_camera);
L000271:             std::int64_t earliest_finish;
L000272:             if (remaining == minimum_remaining.end() ||
L000273:                 !Add(arrival, remaining->second, earliest_finish) || earliest_finish > to_earliest) {
L000274:                 continue;
L000275:             }
L000276:             if (expansions == options.max_expansions) {
L000277:                 segment.search_complete = false;
L000278:                 expansion_limit = true;
L000279:                 return;
L000280:             }
L000281:             ++expansions;
L000282:             if (path.size() >= options.max_hops) {
L000283:                 // The hop cap is a resource limit, never evidence of uniqueness.
L000284:                 segment.search_complete = false;
L000285:                 continue;
L000286:             }
L000287:             path.push_back(edge);
L000288:             if (at_destination) {
L000289:                 auto candidate = EvaluatePath(path, from, to,
L000290:                                               options.travel_time_weight_per_second);
L000291:                 if (candidate) found.push_back(std::move(*candidate));
L000292:             } else {
L000293:                 visited.insert(edge->to_camera);
L000294:                 search(edge->to_camera, arrival);
L000295:                 visited.erase(edge->to_camera);
L000296:             }
L000297:             path.pop_back();
L000298:             if (expansion_limit) return;
L000299:         }
L000300:     };
L000301:     search(from.camera_id, from_latest);
L000302: 
L000303:     std::sort(found.begin(), found.end(), [](const auto& a, const auto& b) {
L000304:         if (a.score != b.score) return a.score > b.score;
L000305:         return PathIdentity(a) < PathIdentity(b);
L000306:     });
L000307:     std::set<RouteIdentity> seen_paths;
L000308:     std::vector<PathCandidate> ranked;
L000309:     for (auto& candidate : found) {
L000310:         if (seen_paths.insert(PathIdentity(candidate)).second) {
L000311:             ranked.push_back(std::move(candidate));
L000312:         }
L000313:     }
L000314:     segment.unique_path = ranked.size() == 1 && segment.search_complete;
L000315:     if (!ranked.empty()) {
L000316:         segment.status = NodeStatus::Inferred;
L000317:         segment.primary = std::move(ranked[0]);
L000318:         for (std::size_t i = 1; i < ranked.size() &&
L000319:                                 i < options.max_candidates; ++i) {
L000320:             if (segment.primary->score - ranked[i].score > options.backup_score_margin) break;
L000321:             segment.backups.push_back(std::move(ranked[i]));
L000322:         }
L000323:     }
L000324:     return segment;
L000325: }
L000326: 
L000327: TrajectorySnapshot BuildSnapshot(const std::string& target_id,
L000328:                                  const std::vector<SightingEvidence>& sightings,
L000329:                                  const CameraGraph& graph,
L000330:                                  const TrajectoryOptions& options,
L000331:                                  std::uint64_t version) {
L000332:     auto built = BuildCameraVisits(sightings, options.max_visit_gap_ms,
L000333:                                    options.max_clock_uncertainty_ms, options.non_overlapping_cameras);
L000334:     TrajectorySnapshot result{target_id, version, graph, options, sightings,
L000335:                               std::move(built.visits), {}, {}, {},
L000336:                               std::move(built.rejected_observation_ids)};
L000337:     const auto adjacency = BuildAdjacency(graph);
L000338:     std::sort(result.visits.begin(), result.visits.end(), [](const auto& a, const auto& b) {
L000339:         return std::tie(a.first_seen_unix_ms, a.last_seen_unix_ms, a.camera_id, a.visit_id) <
L000340:                std::tie(b.first_seen_unix_ms, b.last_seen_unix_ms, b.camera_id, b.visit_id);
L000341:     });
L000342:     for (const auto& visit : result.visits) {
L000343:         result.anchors.push_back({"anchor:" + visit.visit_id, visit.visit_id,
L000344:                                   visit.camera_id, visit.first_seen_unix_ms,
L000345:                                   visit.last_seen_unix_ms,
L000346:                                   visit.first_seen_clock_uncertainty_ms,
L000347:                                   visit.last_seen_clock_uncertainty_ms, visit.time_bounds});
L000348:     }
L000349:     std::size_t frontier = 0;
L000350:     std::vector<std::size_t> tied_frontiers;
L000351:     const auto refresh_frontiers = [&](std::size_t index) {
L000352:         tied_frontiers.push_back(index);
L000353:         std::int64_t latest_lower = std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::min();
L000354:         for (const auto candidate : tied_frontiers) {
L000355:             const auto& anchor = result.anchors[candidate];
L000356:             latest_lower = std::max(latest_lower, anchor.time_bounds.last_earliest_unix_ms);
L000357:         }
L000358:         tied_frontiers.erase(std::remove_if(tied_frontiers.begin(), tied_frontiers.end(),
L000359:             [&](std::size_t candidate) {
L000360:                 const auto& anchor = result.anchors[candidate];
L000361:                 return anchor.time_bounds.last_latest_unix_ms < latest_lower;
L000362:             }), tied_frontiers.end());
L000363:         frontier = tied_frontiers.front();
L000364:     };
L000365:     for (std::size_t i = 0; i < result.anchors.size(); ++i) {
L000366:         const auto& anchor = result.anchors[i];
L000367:         bool new_session = result.sessions.empty();
L000368:         if (!new_session) {
L000369:             const auto& session = result.sessions.back();
L000370:             const auto anchor_earliest = anchor.time_bounds.first_earliest_unix_ms;
L000371:             const auto session_latest = session.time_bounds.last_latest_unix_ms;
L000372:             if (anchor_earliest > session_latest) {
L000373:                 const auto difference = static_cast<std::uint64_t>(anchor_earliest) -
L000374:                                         static_cast<std::uint64_t>(session_latest);
L000375:                 new_session = difference > static_cast<std::uint64_t>(options.session_gap_ms);
L000376:             }
L000377:         }
L000378:         if (new_session) {
L000379:             frontier = i;
L000380:             tied_frontiers = {i};
L000381:             result.sessions.push_back({"session:" + anchor.anchor_id,
L000382:                                        anchor.first_seen_unix_ms, anchor.last_seen_unix_ms,
L000383:                                        anchor.first_seen_clock_uncertainty_ms,
L000384:                                        anchor.last_seen_clock_uncertainty_ms,
L000385:                                        {anchor.anchor_id}, {}, anchor.time_bounds});
L000386:             continue;
L000387:         }
L000388:         auto& session = result.sessions.back();
L000389:         MergeCaptureTimeBounds(session.time_bounds, anchor.time_bounds);
L000390:         auto segment = BuildSegment(result.anchors[frontier], anchor, graph, adjacency, options);
L000391:         if (tied_frontiers.size() > 1) {
L000392:             std::optional<TrajectorySegment> sole_feasible;
L000393:             bool all_complete = true;
L000394:             std::size_t feasible_origins = 0;
L000395:             for (const auto index : tied_frontiers) {
L000396:                 const auto& origin = result.anchors[index];
L000397:                 auto candidate = index == frontier ? segment
L000398:                                                     : BuildSegment(origin, anchor, graph, adjacency, options);
L000399:                 all_complete &= candidate.search_complete;
L000400:                 if (candidate.primary) {
L000401:                     ++feasible_origins;
L000402:                     if (feasible_origins == 1) sole_feasible = std::move(candidate);
L000403:                 }
L000404:             }
L000405:             if (feasible_origins == 1) {
L000406:                 segment = std::move(*sole_feasible);
L000407:                 segment.search_complete = all_complete;
L000408:                 segment.unique_path &= all_complete;
L000409:             } else {
L000410:                 // Clock-overlapping last observations give no supported departure camera.
L000411:                 segment.status = NodeStatus::Unknown;
L000412:                 segment.search_complete = all_complete;
L000413:                 segment.unique_path = false;
L000414:                 segment.primary.reset();
L000415:                 segment.backups.clear();
L000416:             }
L000417:         }
L000418:         session.segment_ids.push_back(segment.segment_id);
L000419:         result.segments.push_back(std::move(segment));
L000420:         session.anchor_ids.push_back(anchor.anchor_id);
L000421:         if (anchor.last_seen_unix_ms > session.last_seen_unix_ms) {
L000422:             session.last_seen_unix_ms = anchor.last_seen_unix_ms;
L000423:             session.last_seen_clock_uncertainty_ms = anchor.last_seen_clock_uncertainty_ms;
L000424:         } else if (anchor.last_seen_unix_ms == session.last_seen_unix_ms) {
L000425:             session.last_seen_clock_uncertainty_ms = std::max(
L000426:                 session.last_seen_clock_uncertainty_ms,
L000427:                 anchor.last_seen_clock_uncertainty_ms);
L000428:         }
L000429:         refresh_frontiers(i);
L000430:     }
L000431:     return result;
L000432: }
L000433: 
L000434: bool SamePath(const PathCandidate& a, const PathCandidate& b) {
L000435:     if (a.score != b.score || a.edge_cost != b.edge_cost ||
L000436:         a.time_penalty != b.time_penalty || a.edge_ids != b.edge_ids ||
L000437:         a.edge_time_bounds != b.edge_time_bounds ||
L000438:         a.nodes.size() != b.nodes.size()) return false;
L000439:     for (std::size_t i = 0; i < a.nodes.size(); ++i) {
L000440:         if (std::tie(a.nodes[i].camera_id, a.nodes[i].status,
L000441:                      a.nodes[i].earliest_unix_ms, a.nodes[i].latest_unix_ms) !=
L000442:             std::tie(b.nodes[i].camera_id, b.nodes[i].status,
L000443:                      b.nodes[i].earliest_unix_ms, b.nodes[i].latest_unix_ms)) return false;
L000444:     }
L000445:     return true;
L000446: }
L000447: 
L000448: bool SameSegment(const TrajectorySegment& a, const TrajectorySegment& b) {
L000449:     if (std::tie(a.graph_version, a.from_unix_ms, a.to_unix_ms, a.status, a.search_complete,
L000450:                  a.unique_path) !=
L000451:         std::tie(b.graph_version, b.from_unix_ms, b.to_unix_ms, b.status, b.search_complete,
L000452:                  b.unique_path) || a.primary.has_value() != b.primary.has_value() ||
L000453:         a.backups.size() != b.backups.size()) return false;
L000454:     if (a.primary && !SamePath(*a.primary, *b.primary)) return false;
L000455:     for (std::size_t i = 0; i < a.backups.size(); ++i) {
L000456:         if (!SamePath(a.backups[i], b.backups[i])) return false;
L000457:     }
L000458:     return true;
L000459: }
L000460: 
L000461: std::vector<std::string> ChangedSegments(const TrajectorySnapshot* previous,
L000462:                                          const TrajectorySnapshot& next) {
L000463:     std::map<std::string, const TrajectorySegment*> old;
L000464:     if (previous) {
L000465:         for (const auto& segment : previous->segments) old[segment.segment_id] = &segment;
L000466:     }
L000467:     std::set<std::string> changed;
L000468:     for (const auto& segment : next.segments) {
L000469:         auto it = old.find(segment.segment_id);
L000470:         if (it == old.end() || !SameSegment(*it->second, segment)) {
L000471:             changed.insert(segment.segment_id);
L000472:         }
L000473:         old.erase(segment.segment_id);
L000474:     }
L000475:     for (const auto& [id, segment] : old) changed.insert(id);
L000476:     return {changed.begin(), changed.end()};
L000477: }
L000478: 
L000479: nlohmann::json AppendTailProof(const TrajectorySnapshot& snapshot) {
L000480:     if(snapshot.visits.empty() || !snapshot.rejected_observation_ids.empty() ||
L000481:        snapshot.visits.size()!=snapshot.anchors.size() || snapshot.sessions.empty()) return nullptr;
L000482:     const auto index=snapshot.anchors.size()-1;
L000483:     const auto& tail=snapshot.anchors.back();
L000484:     // A strictly later observation region excludes old interleaving evidence
L000485:     // that could split/merge the visit or change the incoming frontier.
L000486:     for(std::size_t i=0;i<index;++i)
L000487:         if(snapshot.anchors[i].time_bounds.last_latest_unix_ms>=tail.time_bounds.first_earliest_unix_ms) return nullptr;
L000488:     if(snapshot.sessions.back().anchor_ids.empty() || snapshot.sessions.back().anchor_ids.back()!=tail.anchor_id) return nullptr;
L000489:     nlohmann::json incoming=nullptr;
L000490:     for(std::size_t i=0;i<snapshot.segments.size();++i) {
L000491:         const auto& segment=snapshot.segments[i];
L000492:         if(segment.from_anchor_id==tail.anchor_id) return nullptr;
L000493:         if(segment.to_anchor_id==tail.anchor_id) { if(!incoming.is_null()) return nullptr; incoming=i; }
L000494:     }
L000495:     return {{"visit_index",index},{"anchor_index",index},{"session_index",snapshot.sessions.size()-1},{"incoming_segment_index",incoming}};
L000496: }

L000500: CameraGraph NormalizeCameraGraph(CameraGraph graph) {
L000501:     return CanonicalGraph(std::move(graph));
L000502: }
L000503: 
L000504: std::vector<TrajectoryStore::TimedAnchor> TrajectoryStore::BuildTimelineIndex(
L000505:     const TrajectorySnapshot& snapshot) {
L000506:     std::map<std::string, std::size_t> observation_anchors;
L000507:     for (std::size_t i = 0; i < snapshot.visits.size(); ++i) {
L000508:         for (const auto& id : snapshot.visits[i].observation_ids) {
L000509:             observation_anchors.emplace(id, i);
L000510:         }
L000511:     }
L000512:     std::vector<TimedAnchor> timed;
L000513:     timed.reserve(observation_anchors.size());
L000514:     // Evidence is in observation-ID order. Stable sorting retains its tie rule.
L000515:     for (std::size_t i = 0; i < snapshot.evidence.size(); ++i) {
L000516:         const auto& sighting = snapshot.evidence[i];
L000517:         const auto it = observation_anchors.find(sighting.observation_id);
L000518:         if (it != observation_anchors.end()) {
L000519:             timed.push_back({sighting.captured_at_unix_ms, it->second, i});
L000520:         }
L000521:     }
L000522:     std::stable_sort(timed.begin(), timed.end(), [](const auto& a, const auto& b) {
L000523:         return a.time < b.time;
L000524:     });
L000525:     return timed;
L000526: }
L000527: 
L000528: TrajectoryRevision TrajectoryStore::Rebuild(
L000529:     const std::string& target_id, const std::vector<SightingEvidence>& sightings,
L000530:     const CameraGraph& graph, const TrajectoryOptions& input_options,
L000531:     const std::string& reason, std::optional<std::uint64_t> expected_version) {
L000532:     if (target_id.empty() || reason.empty()) {
L000533:         throw std::invalid_argument("target_id and revision reason are required");
L000534:     }
L000535:     auto options=input_options;
L000536:     for(auto& pair:options.non_overlapping_cameras)if(pair.second<pair.first)std::swap(pair.first,pair.second);
L000537:     std::sort(options.non_overlapping_cameras.begin(),options.non_overlapping_cameras.end());
L000538:     options.non_overlapping_cameras.erase(std::unique(options.non_overlapping_cameras.begin(),options.non_overlapping_cameras.end()),options.non_overlapping_cameras.end());
L000539:     ValidateOptions(options);
L000540:     auto canonical_input = CanonicalSightings(target_id, sightings);
L000541:     auto canonical_graph = NormalizeCameraGraph(graph);
L000542:     const auto association_revision = association_revision_reader_ ? association_revision_reader_(target_id) : 0;
L000543:     const auto check_version = [&](std::uint64_t current, bool identical) {
L000544:         if (expected_version && *expected_version > current)
L000545:             throw std::runtime_error("VERSION_CONFLICT: expected_version is ahead of current trajectory version");
L000546:         // Same current input/binding is a safe retry after an acknowledgement loss.
L000547:         if (identical) return;
L000548:         if ((!expected_version && current != 0) || (expected_version && *expected_version != current))
L000549:             throw std::runtime_error("VERSION_CONFLICT: rebuild requires current expected_version=" + std::to_string(current));
L000550:     };
L000551:     if(state_) {
L000552:         // 相机图文本只序列化一次；库里已有逐字节相同的文本时，既不必解析比较，也不必重写同一行。
L000553:         const auto graph_text=nlohmann::json(canonical_graph).dump();
L000554:         auto known=state_->Get("trajectory_graph",canonical_graph.version);
L000555:         if(known && *known!=graph_text && !SameGraph(nlohmann::json::parse(*known).get<CameraGraph>(),canonical_graph))
L000556:             throw std::invalid_argument("graph edges changed without a new graph version");
L000557:         auto head=state_->Get("trajectory_head",target_id);
L000558:         std::optional<TrajectorySnapshot> previous;
L000559:         if(head)previous=Get(target_id,std::stoull(*head));
L000560:         const bool identical = previous && previous->association_revision == association_revision &&
L000561:             SameSightings(previous->evidence,canonical_input) && SameGraph(previous->graph,canonical_graph) && SameOptions(previous->options,options);
L000562:         check_version(previous ? previous->version : 0, identical);
L000563:         if(identical)
L000564:             return {target_id,previous->version,previous->version,reason,{}};
L000565:         auto version=previous?previous->version+1:1;
L000566:         auto next=BuildSnapshot(target_id,canonical_input,canonical_graph,options,version);
L000567:         next.association_revision = association_revision;
L000568:         TrajectoryRevision revision{target_id,version-1,version,reason,ChangedSegments(previous?&*previous:nullptr,next)};
L000569:         next.revision=revision;
L000570:         const auto key=nlohmann::json::array({target_id,version}).dump();
L000571:         SharedJson shared(*state_);
L000572:         std::optional<nlohmann::json> shared_previous;
L000573:         if(previous) {
L000574:             const auto text=state_->Get("trajectory",nlohmann::json::array({target_id,previous->version}).dump());
L000575:             if(text) { auto encoded=nlohmann::json::parse(*text); if(encoded.value("storage_format","")=="refs-v2") shared_previous=std::move(encoded); }
L000576:         }
L000577:         auto payload=shared.Encode(nlohmann::json(next),false,shared_previous);
L000578:         payload["storage_format"]="refs-v2";
L000579:         payload["append_tail"]=AppendTailProof(next);
L000580:         state_->Put("trajectory",key,payload.dump(),target_id);
L000581:         state_->Put("trajectory_head",target_id,std::to_string(version));
L000582:         if(!known || *known!=graph_text) state_->Put("trajectory_graph",canonical_graph.version,graph_text);
L000583:         auto timed=BuildTimelineIndex(next);
L000584:         cold_cache_=StoredSnapshot{std::move(next),std::move(timed)};
L000585:         return revision;
L000586:     }
L000587:     auto it = histories_.find(target_id);
L000588:     if (it != histories_.end()) {
L000589:         for (const auto& stored : it->second.snapshots) {
L000590:             const auto& snapshot = stored.snapshot;
L000591:             if (snapshot.graph.version == canonical_graph.version &&
L000592:                 !SameGraph(snapshot.graph, canonical_graph)) {
L000593:                 throw std::invalid_argument("graph edges changed without a new graph version");
L000594:             }
L000595:         }
L000596:     }
L000597:     const bool identical = it != histories_.end() &&
L000598:         it->second.snapshots.back().snapshot.association_revision == association_revision &&
L000599:         SameSightings(it->second.snapshots.back().snapshot.evidence, canonical_input) &&
L000600:         SameGraph(it->second.snapshots.back().snapshot.graph, canonical_graph) &&
L000601:         SameOptions(it->second.snapshots.back().snapshot.options, options);
L000602:     const auto previous_version = it == histories_.end() ? 0 : it->second.snapshots.back().snapshot.version;
L000603:     check_version(previous_version, identical);
L000604:     if (identical) {
L000605:         const auto version = it->second.snapshots.back().snapshot.version;
L000606:         return {target_id, version, version, reason, {}};
L000607:     }
L000608:     auto next = BuildSnapshot(target_id, canonical_input, canonical_graph, options,
L000609:                               previous_version + 1);
L000610:     next.association_revision = association_revision;
L000611:     const auto previous = it == histories_.end() ? nullptr : &it->second.snapshots.back().snapshot;
L000612:     auto affected = ChangedSegments(previous, next);
L000613:     TrajectoryRevision revision{target_id, previous_version, previous_version + 1, reason,
L000614:                                 std::move(affected)};
L000615:     next.revision = revision;
L000616:     auto timed = BuildTimelineIndex(next);
L000617:     auto& history = histories_[target_id];
L000618:     history.snapshots.push_back({std::move(next), std::move(timed)});
L000619:     return revision;
L000620: }
L000621: 
L000622: std::optional<TrajectoryRevision> TrajectoryStore::TryAppend(
L000623:     const SightingEvidence& sighting, std::uint64_t previous_association_revision,
L000624:     const CameraGraph& graph, const TrajectoryOptions& input_options,
L000625:     const std::string& reason, std::uint64_t expected_version) {
L000626:     if(!state_ || expected_version==0 || reason.empty() ||
L000627:        LatestVersion(sighting.target_id)!=expected_version) return {};
L000628:     const auto text=state_->Get("trajectory",nlohmann::json::array({sighting.target_id,expected_version}).dump());
L000629:     if(!text) return {};
L000630:     auto payload=nlohmann::json::parse(*text);
L000631:     if(payload.value("storage_format","")!="refs-v2" ||
L000632:        payload.at("association_revision").get<std::uint64_t>()!=previous_association_revision) return {};
L000633:     auto options=input_options;
L000634:     for(auto& pair:options.non_overlapping_cameras) if(pair.second<pair.first) std::swap(pair.first,pair.second);
L000635:     std::sort(options.non_overlapping_cameras.begin(),options.non_overlapping_cameras.end());
L000636:     options.non_overlapping_cameras.erase(std::unique(options.non_overlapping_cameras.begin(),options.non_overlapping_cameras.end()),options.non_overlapping_cameras.end());
L000637:     ValidateOptions(options);
L000638:     SharedJson shared(*state_);
L000639:     if(!SameGraph(shared.Decode(payload.at("graph")).get<CameraGraph>(),NormalizeCameraGraph(graph)) ||
L000640:        !SameOptions(shared.Decode(payload.at("options")).get<TrajectoryOptions>(),options)) return {};
L000641:     // The complete builder certifies the last visit as strictly later than
L000642:     // every other anchor. Missing/ambiguous certificates use the complete core.
L000643:     if(!payload.contains("append_tail") || payload.at("append_tail").is_null() ||
L000644:        SharedJson::Count(payload.at("rejected_observation_ids"))!=0 || !sighting.reentry_evidence_id.empty()) return {};
L000645:     const auto& proof=payload.at("append_tail");
L000646:     const auto visit_index=proof.at("visit_index").get<std::size_t>();
L000647:     const auto anchor_index=proof.at("anchor_index").get<std::size_t>();
L000648:     const auto session_index=proof.at("session_index").get<std::size_t>();
L000649:     auto visit=shared.At(payload.at("visits"),visit_index);
L000650:     const auto last=visit.at("last_seen_unix_ms").get<std::int64_t>();
L000651:     if(visit.at("camera_id")!=sighting.camera_id || sighting.captured_at_unix_ms<=last ||
L000652:        static_cast<std::uint64_t>(sighting.captured_at_unix_ms)-static_cast<std::uint64_t>(last)>
L000653:          static_cast<std::uint64_t>(options.max_visit_gap_ms)) return {};
L000654:     const auto admitted=BuildCameraVisits({sighting},options.max_visit_gap_ms,options.max_clock_uncertainty_ms,options.non_overlapping_cameras);
L000655:     if(admitted.visits.size()!=1 || !admitted.rejected_observation_ids.empty()) return {};
L000656:     const auto association_revision=association_revision_reader_?association_revision_reader_(sighting.target_id):0;
L000657:     if(association_revision<=previous_association_revision) return {};
L000658:     const auto old_bounds=visit.at("time_bounds").get<CaptureTimeBounds>();
L000659:     auto bounds=old_bounds;
L000660:     MergeCaptureTimeBounds(bounds,admitted.visits.front().time_bounds);
L000661:     // First bounds drive incoming travel feasibility, edge windows, scores and
L000662:     // session partitioning. Changing either requires full reconstruction.
L000663:     if(visit_index!=0 && (bounds.first_earliest_unix_ms!=old_bounds.first_earliest_unix_ms ||
L000664:         bounds.first_latest_unix_ms!=old_bounds.first_latest_unix_ms)) return {};
L000665:     visit["time_bounds"]=bounds;
L000666:     visit["last_seen_unix_ms"]=sighting.captured_at_unix_ms;
L000667:     visit["last_seen_clock_uncertainty_ms"]=sighting.clock_uncertainty_ms;
L000668:     visit["max_clock_uncertainty_ms"]=std::max(visit.at("max_clock_uncertainty_ms").get<std::int64_t>(),sighting.clock_uncertainty_ms);
L000669:     shared.Append(visit["observation_ids"],sighting.observation_id);
L000670:     shared.Append(visit["attribution_evidence_ids"],sighting.attribution_evidence_id);
L000671:     shared.Append(visit["source_ids"],sighting.source_id);
L000672:     shared.Set(payload["visits"],visit_index,visit);
L000673:     auto anchor=shared.At(payload.at("anchors"),anchor_index), session=shared.At(payload.at("sessions"),session_index);
L000674:     auto session_bounds=session.at("time_bounds").get<CaptureTimeBounds>();
L000675:     MergeCaptureTimeBounds(session_bounds,bounds);
L000676:     for(auto* item:{&anchor,&session}) {
L000677:         (*item)["last_seen_unix_ms"]=sighting.captured_at_unix_ms;
L000678:         (*item)["last_seen_clock_uncertainty_ms"]=sighting.clock_uncertainty_ms;
L000679:     }
L000680:     anchor["time_bounds"]=bounds; session["time_bounds"]=session_bounds;
L000681:     shared.Set(payload["anchors"],anchor_index,anchor); shared.Set(payload["sessions"],session_index,session);
L000682:     shared.InsertEvidence(payload["evidence"],nlohmann::json(sighting));
L000683:     TrajectoryRevision revision{sighting.target_id,expected_version,expected_version+1,reason,{}};
L000684:     if(!proof.at("incoming_segment_index").is_null()) {
L000685:         const auto segment_index=proof.at("incoming_segment_index").get<std::size_t>();
L000686:         const auto encoded=shared.At(payload.at("segments"),segment_index);
L000687:         const auto old_segment=shared.Decode(encoded).get<TrajectorySegment>();
L000688:         auto segment=old_segment;
L000689:         const auto extend=[&](PathCandidate& candidate) {
L000690:             if(candidate.nodes.empty() || candidate.nodes.back().camera_id!=sighting.camera_id)
L000691:                 throw std::logic_error("invalid certified incoming trajectory endpoint");
L000692:             candidate.nodes.back().latest_unix_ms=bounds.last_latest_unix_ms;
L000693:         };
L000694:         if(segment.primary) extend(*segment.primary);
L000695:         for(auto& candidate:segment.backups) extend(candidate);
L000696:         if(!SameSegment(old_segment,segment)) {
L000697:             revision.affected_segment_ids.push_back(segment.segment_id);
L000698:             shared.Set(payload["segments"],segment_index,shared.Encode(nlohmann::json(segment),false,std::optional<nlohmann::json>(encoded)));
L000699:         }
L000700:     }
L000701:     payload["revision"]=shared.Encode(nlohmann::json(revision));
L000702:     payload["version"]=revision.version; payload["association_revision"]=association_revision;
L000703:     state_->Put("trajectory",nlohmann::json::array({sighting.target_id,revision.version}).dump(),payload.dump(),sighting.target_id);
L000704:     state_->Put("trajectory_head",sighting.target_id,std::to_string(revision.version));
L000705:     cold_cache_.reset();
L000706:     return revision;
L000707: }
L000708: 
L000709: TrajectoryReference TrajectoryStore::Reference(const std::string& target_id,std::uint64_t version) const {
L000710:     if(state_) {
L000711:         if(version==0) version=LatestVersion(target_id);
L000712:         const auto text=state_->Get("trajectory",nlohmann::json::array({target_id,version}).dump());
L000713:         if(!text) throw std::out_of_range("trajectory version not found");
L000714:         const auto payload=nlohmann::json::parse(*text);
L000715:         if(payload.value("storage_format","")=="refs-v2") return {version,payload.at("association_revision"),
L000716:             SharedJson::Count(payload.at("evidence")),SharedJson::Count(payload.at("anchors")),payload.at("graph").at("version")};
L000717:     }
L000718:     const auto& snapshot=Get(target_id,version);
L000719:     return {snapshot.version,snapshot.association_revision,snapshot.evidence.size(),snapshot.anchors.size(),snapshot.graph.version};
L000720: }
L000721: 
L000722: const TrajectorySnapshot& TrajectoryStore::Get(const std::string& target_id,
L000723:                                                 std::uint64_t version) const {
L000724:     if (version == 0 && association_revision_reader_) {
L000725:         const auto source_revision = association_revision_reader_(target_id);
L000726:         if (source_revision != 0 && LatestVersion(target_id) == 0)
L000727:             throw std::runtime_error("REBUILD_REQUIRED: no trajectory for current association; target=" + target_id);
L000728:         const auto& snapshot = Find(target_id, 0).snapshot;
L000729:         if (snapshot.association_revision != source_revision)
L000730:             throw std::runtime_error("REBUILD_REQUIRED: association revision changed; target=" + target_id +
L000731:                 "; current trajectory version=" + std::to_string(snapshot.version));
L000732:         return snapshot;
L000733:     }
L000734:     return Find(target_id, version).snapshot;
L000735: }
L000736: 
L000737: std::uint64_t TrajectoryStore::LatestVersion(const std::string& target) const {
L000738:     if (state_) return std::stoull(state_->Get("trajectory_head", target).value_or("0"));
L000739:     const auto found = histories_.find(target);
L000740:     return found == histories_.end() ? 0 : found->second.snapshots.back().snapshot.version;
L000741: }
L000742: 
L000743: nlohmann::json TrajectoryStore::Prune(std::int64_t cutoff_unix_ms, bool dry_run,
L000744:                                     const std::vector<std::string>& expired_observation_ids) {
L000745:     using J=nlohmann::json;
L000746:     // Snapshot versions are immutable to writers, but retention redacts all
L000747:     // of them. Removing only the head would leave queryable historical points.
L000748:     struct Candidate {
L000749:         std::string key;
L000750:         TrajectorySnapshot before;
L000751:         std::vector<SightingEvidence> retained;
L000752:     };
L000753:     std::vector<Candidate> candidates;
L000754:     if(state_) {
L000755:         std::vector<std::pair<std::string,std::string>> keys;
L000756:         state_->Scan("trajectory",[&](const std::string& key,const std::string& value){keys.emplace_back(key,value);});
L000757:         for(const auto& item:keys) {
L000758:             const auto key=J::parse(item.first);
L000759:             if(!key.is_array() || key.size()!=2)throw std::runtime_error("invalid persisted trajectory key");
L000760:             // Explicit versions avoid the association current-head assertion.
L000761:             candidates.push_back({item.first,Get(key.at(0).get<std::string>(),key.at(1).get<std::uint64_t>()),{}});
L000762:         }
L000763:     } else {
L000764:         for(const auto& target:histories_)for(const auto& stored:target.second.snapshots)
L000765:             candidates.push_back({J::array({target.first,stored.snapshot.version}).dump(),stored.snapshot,{}});
L000766:     }
L000767:     std::set<std::string> removed(expired_observation_ids.begin(),expired_observation_ids.end());
L000768:     std::set<std::string> removed_from_snapshots;
L000769:     std::uint64_t evidence_before=0,evidence_after=0,unknown_removed=0;
L000770:     for(auto& item:candidates) {
L000771:         for(const auto& sighting:item.before.evidence) {
L000772:             ++evidence_before;
L000773:             const bool qualified=sighting.time_source==TimeSource::UtcCapture && sighting.clock_domain=="UTC" &&
L000774:                 sighting.clock_uncertainty_ms>=0 && sighting.clock_uncertainty_ms<=60000;
L000775:             // An old snapshot has no first-quarantine provenance. Unqualified
L000776:             // evidence was never usable as a point, so remove it immediately
L000777:             // rather than inventing a fresh retention lease during migration.
L000778:             if(!qualified || removed.count(sighting.observation_id) || sighting.captured_at_unix_ms<cutoff_unix_ms) {
L000779:                 removed.insert(sighting.observation_id);
L000780:                 removed_from_snapshots.insert(sighting.observation_id);
L000781:                 if(!qualified)++unknown_removed;
L000782:             } else {
L000783:                 item.retained.push_back(sighting);
L000784:                 ++evidence_after;
L000785:             }
L000786:         }
L000787:     }
L000788:     std::uint64_t rewritten=0,deleted=0,empty_versions=0,rejected_removed=0,revision_ids_removed=0,reentry_removed=0;
L000789:     auto earliest=std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::max();
L000790:     for(auto& item:candidates) {
L000791:         // A removal discovered in another historical version is authoritative
L000792:         // for the same immutable observation ID throughout this scope.
L000793:         item.retained.erase(std::remove_if(item.retained.begin(),item.retained.end(),[&](const auto& sighting){
L000794:             if(!removed.count(sighting.observation_id))return false;
L000795:             --evidence_after;
L000796:             return true;
L000797:         }),item.retained.end());
L000798:         bool scrubbed_reentry=false;
L000799:         for(auto& sighting:item.retained) {
L000800:             earliest=std::min(earliest,sighting.captured_at_unix_ms);
L000801:             if(!sighting.reentry_evidence_id.empty() && removed.count(sighting.reentry_evidence_id)) {
L000802:                 sighting.reentry_evidence_id.clear();scrubbed_reentry=true;++reentry_removed;
L000803:             }
L000804:         }
L000805:         auto next=BuildSnapshot(item.before.target_id,item.retained,item.before.graph,item.before.options,item.before.version);
L000806:         next.association_revision=item.before.association_revision;
L000807:         next.revision=item.before.revision;
L000808:         std::set<std::string> surviving_segments;
L000809:         for(const auto& segment:next.segments)surviving_segments.insert(segment.segment_id);
L000810:         auto& affected=next.revision.affected_segment_ids;
L000811:         const auto affected_before=affected.size();
L000812:         affected.erase(std::remove_if(affected.begin(),affected.end(),[&](const auto& id){return !surviving_segments.count(id);}),affected.end());
L000813:         revision_ids_removed+=affected_before-affected.size();
L000814:         std::set<std::string> surviving_rejected(next.rejected_observation_ids.begin(),next.rejected_observation_ids.end());
L000815:         std::uint64_t dropped_rejected=0;
L000816:         for(const auto& id:item.before.rejected_observation_ids)if(!surviving_rejected.count(id))++dropped_rejected;
L000817:         rejected_removed+=dropped_rejected;
L000818:         bool expired_reason=false;
L000819:         for(const auto& id:removed)if(!id.empty() && next.revision.reason.find(id)!=std::string::npos){expired_reason=true;break;}
L000820:         const bool changed=item.retained.size()!=item.before.evidence.size() || scrubbed_reentry ||
L000821:             dropped_rejected!=0 || affected_before!=affected.size() || expired_reason;
L000822:         if(next.evidence.empty()) {
L000823:             ++empty_versions;
L000824:             if(next.version!=LatestVersion(next.target_id)) {
L000825:                 ++deleted;
L000826:                 if(!dry_run) {
L000827:                     if(state_)state_->Erase("trajectory",item.key);
L000828:                     else {
L000829:                         auto& snapshots=histories_.at(next.target_id).snapshots;
L000830:                         snapshots.erase(std::remove_if(snapshots.begin(),snapshots.end(),[&](const auto& stored){
L000831:                             return stored.snapshot.version==next.version;
L000832:                         }),snapshots.end());
L000833:                     }
L000834:                 }
L000835:                 continue;
L000836:             }
L000837:         }
L000838:         if(!changed)continue;
L000839:         ++rewritten;
L000840:         // Historical revision free text can embed raw observation IDs. A
L000841:         // stable reason replaces it rather than retaining expired provenance.
L000842:         next.revision.reason="RETENTION_PRUNE";
L000843:         if(dry_run)continue;
L000844:         if(state_) {
L000845:             SharedJson shared(*state_);
L000846:             auto payload=shared.Encode(J(next));
L000847:             payload["storage_format"]="refs-v2";
L000848:             payload["append_tail"]=AppendTailProof(next);
L000849:             state_->Put("trajectory",item.key,payload.dump(),next.target_id);
L000850:         } else {
L000851:             auto& snapshots=histories_.at(next.target_id).snapshots;
L000852:             const auto found=std::find_if(snapshots.begin(),snapshots.end(),[&](const auto& stored){return stored.snapshot.version==next.version;});
L000853:             if(found==snapshots.end())throw std::logic_error("trajectory history disappeared during retention");
L000854:             auto timed=BuildTimelineIndex(next);
L000855:             *found=StoredSnapshot{std::move(next),std::move(timed)};
L000856:         }
L000857:     }
L000858:     if(!dry_run)cold_cache_.reset();
L000859:     return {{"cutoff_unix_ms",cutoff_unix_ms},{"dry_run",dry_run},{"versions_scanned",candidates.size()},
L000860:         {"earliest_retained_capture_unix_ms",earliest},
L000861:         {"versions_rewritten",rewritten},{"versions_deleted",deleted},{"empty_versions",empty_versions},{"evidence_before",evidence_before},
L000862:         {"evidence_after",evidence_after},{"evidence_removed",evidence_before-evidence_after},
L000863:         {"distinct_removed_observations",removed_from_snapshots.size()},{"unknown_time_evidence_removed",unknown_removed},
L000864:         {"rejected_ids_removed",rejected_removed},{"revision_ids_removed",revision_ids_removed},{"reentry_ids_removed",reentry_removed}};
L000865: }
L000866: 
L000867: const TrajectoryStore::StoredSnapshot& TrajectoryStore::Find(
L000868:     const std::string& target_id, std::uint64_t version) const {
L000869:     if(state_) {
L000870:         if(version==0){auto head=state_->Get("trajectory_head",target_id);if(!head)throw std::out_of_range("target trajectory not found");version=std::stoull(*head);}
L000871:         if(cold_cache_ && cold_cache_->snapshot.target_id==target_id && cold_cache_->snapshot.version==version)return *cold_cache_;
L000872:         auto text=state_->Get("trajectory",nlohmann::json::array({target_id,version}).dump());
L000873:         if(!text)throw std::out_of_range("trajectory version not found");
L000874:         auto payload=nlohmann::json::parse(*text);
L000875:         if(payload.value("storage_format","")=="refs-v2") {
L000876:             SharedJson shared(*state_); payload=shared.Decode(payload);
L000877:         } else if(payload.contains("storage_format")) {
L000878:             if(payload.at("storage_format")!="refs-v1")throw std::runtime_error("unsupported trajectory storage format");
L000879:             auto object=[&](const std::string& key){auto value=state_->Get("object",key);if(!value)throw std::runtime_error("missing immutable trajectory object");return nlohmann::json::parse(*value);};
L000880:             payload["graph"]=object(payload.at("graph_ref").get<std::string>());
L000881:             payload["evidence"]=nlohmann::json::array();
L000882:             for(const auto& key:payload.at("evidence_refs"))payload["evidence"].push_back(object(key.get<std::string>()));
L000883:         }
L000884:         if (!payload.contains("association_revision")) payload["association_revision"] = 0;
L000885:         auto snapshot=payload.get<TrajectorySnapshot>();
L000886:         auto timed=BuildTimelineIndex(snapshot);cold_cache_=StoredSnapshot{std::move(snapshot),std::move(timed)};
L000887:         return *cold_cache_;
L000888:     }
L000889:     auto it = histories_.find(target_id);
L000890:     if (it == histories_.end() || it->second.snapshots.empty()) {
L000891:         throw std::out_of_range("target trajectory not found");
L000892:     }
L000893:     if (version == 0) return it->second.snapshots.back();
L000894:     const auto found=std::find_if(it->second.snapshots.begin(),it->second.snapshots.end(),[&](const auto& stored){
L000895:         return stored.snapshot.version==version;
L000896:     });
L000897:     if(found==it->second.snapshots.end())throw std::out_of_range("trajectory version not found");
L000898:     return *found;
L000899: }
L000900: 
L000901: TimelineResult TrajectoryStore::Query(const std::string& target_id,
L000902:                                       std::uint64_t version, std::int64_t at_unix_ms,
L000903:                                       std::int64_t from_unix_ms,
L000904:                                       std::int64_t to_unix_ms) const {
L000905:     if (from_unix_ms > at_unix_ms || at_unix_ms > to_unix_ms) {
L000906:         throw std::invalid_argument("timeline range must contain at_unix_ms");
L000907:     }
L000908:     if (version == 0) (void)Get(target_id, 0); // current reads must use current identity evidence
L000909:     const auto& stored = Find(target_id, version);
L000910:     const auto& snapshot = stored.snapshot;
L000911:     TimelineResult result{target_id, snapshot.version, at_unix_ms, NodeStatus::Unknown,
L000912:                           {}, {}, std::nullopt, std::nullopt, std::nullopt, {}, {}};
L000913:     for (const auto& anchor : snapshot.anchors) {
L000914:         if (anchor.time_bounds.first_earliest_unix_ms <= to_unix_ms &&
L000915:             anchor.time_bounds.last_latest_unix_ms >= from_unix_ms) result.anchors_in_range.push_back(anchor);
L000916:     }
L000917:     const auto& timed = stored.timed_anchors;
L000918:     const auto error=snapshot.options.max_clock_uncertainty_ms;
L000919:     const auto lower=at_unix_ms<std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::min()+error
L000920:         ?std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::min():at_unix_ms-error;
L000921:     const auto upper=at_unix_ms>std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::max()-error
L000922:         ?std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::max():at_unix_ms+error;
L000923:     auto possible_begin=std::lower_bound(timed.begin(),timed.end(),lower,
L000924:         [](const TimedAnchor& item,std::int64_t time){return item.time<time;});
L000925:     auto possible_end=std::upper_bound(possible_begin,timed.end(),upper,
L000926:         [](std::int64_t time,const TimedAnchor& item){return time<item.time;});
L000927:     std::set<std::string> possible;
L000928:     for(auto it=possible_begin;it!=possible_end;++it){
L000929:         const auto& capture=snapshot.evidence[it->evidence_index];
L000930:         const auto distance=it->time<=at_unix_ms
L000931:             ?static_cast<std::uint64_t>(at_unix_ms)-static_cast<std::uint64_t>(it->time)
L000932:             :static_cast<std::uint64_t>(it->time)-static_cast<std::uint64_t>(at_unix_ms);

L000935:     }
L000936:     for(const auto& anchor:snapshot.anchors)if(possible.count(anchor.anchor_id))

L000939:         [](std::int64_t time, const TimedAnchor& item) { return time < item.time; });

L000941:         [](const TimedAnchor& item,std::int64_t time){return item.time<time;});

L000945:             result.observed_anchor_ids.push_back(id);
L000946:     }
L000947:     if (after != timed.end()) {

L000949:         result.next_observation = TimelineObservation{
L000950:             *result.next_anchor_id, snapshot.evidence[after->evidence_index]};
L000951:     }
L000952:     if (after != timed.begin()) {
L000953:         const auto previous_time = (after - 1)->time;
L000954:         const auto first_at_time = std::lower_bound(timed.begin(), after, previous_time,
L000955:             [](const TimedAnchor& item, std::int64_t time) { return item.time < time; });
L000956:         result.previous_anchor_id = snapshot.anchors[first_at_time->anchor_index].anchor_id;
L000957:         result.previous_observation = TimelineObservation{
L000958:             *result.previous_anchor_id, snapshot.evidence[first_at_time->evidence_index]};
L000959:     }

L000961:                             std::size_t route_index) {

L000963:         for (std::size_t i = 0; i < path.nodes.size(); ++i) {
L000964:             const auto& node = path.nodes[i];
L000965:             if (node.earliest_unix_ms <= at_unix_ms && at_unix_ms <= node.latest_unix_ms) {
L000966:                 location.node_indices.push_back(i);
L000967:             }
L000968:         }
L000969:         for (std::size_t i = 0; i < path.edge_time_bounds.size(); ++i) {
L000970:             const auto& bound = path.edge_time_bounds[i];
L000971:             if (bound.earliest_unix_ms <= at_unix_ms && at_unix_ms <= bound.latest_unix_ms) {
L000972:                 location.edge_indices.push_back(i);
L000973:             }
L000974:         }
L000975:         if (!location.node_indices.empty() || !location.edge_indices.empty()) {
L000976:             result.path_locations.push_back(std::move(location));
L000977:         }
L000978:     };
L000979:     for (const auto& segment : snapshot.segments) {
L000980:         const auto start = std::min(segment.from_unix_ms, segment.to_unix_ms);
L000981:         const auto end = std::max(segment.from_unix_ms, segment.to_unix_ms);
L000982:         if (start <= to_unix_ms && end >= from_unix_ms) {
L000983:             result.segments_in_range.push_back(segment);
L000984:         }
L000985:         if (start <= at_unix_ms && end >= at_unix_ms) {
L000986:             result.active_segment_ids.push_back(segment.segment_id);
L000987:             if (segment.primary) locate(segment, *segment.primary, 0);
L000988:             for (std::size_t i = 0; i < segment.backups.size(); ++i) {
L000989:                 locate(segment, segment.backups[i], i + 1);
L000990:             }
L000991:         }
L000992:     }
L000993:     if (result.active_segment_ids.size() == 1) {
L000994:         result.segment_id = result.active_segment_ids[0];

L000998:     }
L000999:     if (!result.observed_anchor_ids.empty()) result.status = NodeStatus::Observed;
L001000:     else if (!result.possible_observed_anchor_ids.empty()) result.status = NodeStatus::Unknown;

L001002: }

L000037: CaptureTimeBounds TimeBounds(const SightingEvidence& sighting) {

L000041:         ? std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::min() : time - error;
L000042:     const auto upper = time > std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::max() - error
L000043:         ? std::numeric_limits<std::int64_t>::max() : time + error;
L000044:     return {lower, upper, lower, upper};
